reviews.text: The decor and ambiance were amazing, I wish the food matched that.  It was so disappointing, we waited over 90 minutes for our entrees.  The music was great but so loud that the 9 of us couldn't talk at the table and we felt like we were just sitting there... when the food finally came it was nothing special, the brisket was tough in the bolognese, the risotto tasted like truffle oil, which it did not have in it.  Our waitress knew it was taking for ever and brought us complimentary shots which were really terrible and overly sour...one person had to get to get up and run to the bathroom.  We were so excited to come here and for $800 the meal should have been spectacular.
reviews.author: Lohanna H.

reviews.text: Such a cute atmosphere! I love the boogie dark esthetics. Music was a vibe. The fruit cobbler and the drinks were delicious. Everyone was nice and welcoming. They remember us the next day we had went which was nice  no complaints.
reviews.author: Amber A.

reviews.text: Ashton was very good and provided my friends and I very good service during our dinner!! Would recommend this place to anyone! Great food and ambiance!!! Ask for Ashton as your server!
reviews.author: Emma G.

reviews.text: I can't get enough of this place. I've had Barrett the two times I've been here and genuinely he is the best! He gave so many good recommendations on drinks and food, I couldn't have had a better experience!
reviews.author: Sydney G.

reviews.text: Anna was the best server! She knew the menu by heart and gave us the best food recommendation. The risotto and bolognese were amazing. Will be returning.
reviews.author: Mary Kate K.

reviews.text: This place really screams Lisa Vanderpump! We loved the goat cheese balls and the PUMPTINI!! Shout out to our waiter Barret he was so sweet and attentive. 10/10 recommend
reviews.author: Savanna C.

reviews.text: Me and my best friend loved this restaurant! The food was really good (get the goat cheese balls). Barret was genuinely the best waiter we could've had. So attentive and kind! definitely would come back for just him alone
reviews.author: JerryDawn G.

reviews.text: Anna changed the trajectory of my trip to Scottsdale. she was helpful, conscientious, kind, and attentive.
reviews.author: Victoria B.

reviews.text: ANNA was the best! So kind and a great vibe :) !!!!!!! she was so amazing and great table manners
reviews.author: Lauren S.

reviews.text: We had an amazing experience last night thanks to Amy. She went above and beyond and made our whole time there great. The place itself is very cool but the service we had made it memorable. Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Daniel H.

reviews.text: This restaurant is a whole vibe!! Beautiful, opulent, just the right amount of dark and moody and luxurious without feeling pretentious. The views are stunning! The food and drinks were fabulous. 3 of us had mid-afternoon appetizers: goat cheese balls, tuna tartar tostadas and the risotto which was perfect for us to share...our Server, Anna, was so amazing at providing these recommendations and even added a goat cheese ball to the typical order of 5 to allow us to have two each! Our drinks were just as delicious: Desert Nectar was a favorite! I tried Gold Water and again our Server Anna was such an angel when I said it wasn't quite what I was expecting, replaced it with no problem yet allowed the table to keep the original so the others could try it!! I opted for the Snowbird and LOVED it!! Such a great experience - highly recommend this restaraunt!!
reviews.author: Michelle B.

reviews.text: I'd go back here a million times. Great views, wonderful service and the food was truly amazing!!!
reviews.author: Michelle D.

reviews.text: Our girl group sat down for dinner at 6:30pm, and they opened the shades once the sun set for a beautiful mountain view. The music was great when we got there, but they switched up the playlist to a totally different vibe that we didn't love. Our waitress, Anna, was so lively and attentive. She made our group feel very welcome. We ordered a round of cocktails (the Pumptini was delicious and tart but very sweet), the famous goat cheese balls (comes with five balls), the lobster ceviche crisps (comes with three crisps, which are basically thin tacos, but we added a fourth so we each could have one), two tricolore risottos, and two butter seared Chilean seabass. The risotto was a bit crunchier than I expected and had some spice to it. The seabass was cooked perfectly but could've had a stronger lemon caper flavor. Though it's not listed on the menu as part of the dish description, it's worth noting that the seabass came with mixed vegetables and perfectly cooked thinly sliced potatoes. The lobster ceviche crisps were pretty underwhelming. The lobster was a good texture but lacked flavor. The goat cheese balls were crispy on the outside and soft on the inside and tasted delicious with the honey served beneath them. Anna said that her favorite item on the menu is the tuna tartare tostadas, so I'd try those instead if I come back.
reviews.author: Alexandra S.

reviews.text: I had an amazing time at Wolf. Zeta was our server and she was very attentive and super nice. I asked her about the fish and chips and her description of it being light and not oily was perfect, they were great.
reviews.author: Lauren B.

reviews.text: Loved the service, all servers were knowledgeable, and made the experience enjoyable. Anna was a great server. Loved it.
reviews.author: Zoe W.

reviews.text: Alicia was such a great server, she was sweet and attentive! The restaurant exceeded my expectations and was overall a great experience. I got the aperol spritz and the burger and both were bigger and more delicious than i was expecting. 10/10, Lisa did it again!
reviews.author: Miranda h.

reviews.text:
Made a reservation and walked over from a local hotel, Wolf is located inside the Caesar's Republic Hilton, just a short walk from the north entrance of Macy's at Fashion Sq

The restaurant is surprisingly spacious inside, lots of tables with views of the mountain to the north and the pool area. 

Tables are well spread out, interior is dark (at night) full of custom unique chandeliers; some that rotate slowly.  Dimly lit, but very trendy and although no formal dress code, definitely a place that makes you want to dress up for. 

Food selection is small, varied and prices are reasonable.  Portions are small in a good way, plenty of drink options from the huge bar. 

Service was great, little slow at the start to make an orde but perfect from there on. 

Definitely a place we'll go back to to try more food and cocktails.  

Very unique for Scottsdale and definitely a place to bookmark.
reviews.author: Had R.

reviews.text:
I really wanted to love this place because the ambiance is fantastic. The decor is beautiful, the energy is fun, and it's a great spot for cocktails, date night, or meeting up with friends. If you're looking for a great vibe and a picture-worthy restaurant, this is it.

Unfortunately, the service didn't match the price tag. There were four of us, and our bill was just under $800. At that level, I expect attention to detail.

I ordered a bottle of champagne, yet I ended up refilling my own glass most of the night because it was rarely topped off. After our appetizers, we had to flag someone down to clear our table and bring fresh plates and utensils before our next course.

The biggest miss was my entrée. I ordered my steak on the side, cooked medium rare. It was forgotten entirely, and when it finally arrived, it was well done. The manager apologized, had a new one made, and removed it from the bill, which I appreciated.

Mistakes happen, but there were just too many for a restaurant at this price point.

Would I come back? For cocktails, the atmosphere, and the beautiful space--absolutely. For an expensive dinner, probably not.
reviews.author: Jessica G.

reviews.text: zeta was the best! this place is so professional and caring. we were on a bachelorette trip and they were so tolerant of us taking pics and being silly. food was amazing and pump tini tower was perfect.
reviews.author: Katelyn Iris F.

reviews.text: This restaurant had pros and cons for me. What drew us to it was that it's a Lisa Vanderpump restaurant. The decor was incredible and so was the view from our window seat. Lots of nice touches everywhere. The drinks were good but very inconsistent. I ordered the same drink Gold Rush margarita and it came out different each time and only once with the gold flakes it advertises. The staff and server were nice however there were long periods when we were wanting to order more drinks and food and our server was no where in sight even though it wasn't busy at all as it was 4:40pm. On the other hand the food service was extremely quick. The presentation of the food and drinks was incredible. We enjoyed the Wolf bread and the shrimp tacos the most. My husband said his burger was so so. I'm really glad I got to experience this restaurant for our date night but probably won't be back.
reviews.author: Erin H.

reviews.text: I had Alicia and she was AMAZING. It's giving baddie who knows how to help fellow  baddies have a good time. LOVE HER-and love the restauran!! I wanna be a Vanderpump
reviews.author: Mia R.

reviews.text: Ashton was amazing!! the food and atmosphere was incredible! I came to celebrate my bday and I was not disappointed !!!!!
reviews.author: Erica A.

reviews.text: Absolutely gorgeous from the moment, we stepped in till the end of our dinner. I booked this restaurant for my best friend. She's the bride and I'm the maid of honor. I felt honored to find restaurants that fit into our itinerary, and Vanderpump was one of them. The service was phenomenal. The waitress took care of us from start to finish. She was so kind. Everybody that walked by smiled. The drinks were top-notch tasting and beautiful. The food came out. It was phenomenal. Some of the best food I have ever had. The prices were reasonable as well. This restaurant was definitely an experience and it will always be memorable. I would definitely come back over and over again. Don't forget to order the churros for dessert! Cheers!
reviews.author: Julie M.

reviews.text: This place is pretty awesome. Feels very dark and moody a good mix of like a game of thrones and just a cool cavern of sorts. Great cocktails. Service is top notch very attentive staff that are very knowledgeable about the menu. I ended up having the chicken and my wife had the ribeye (save the jokes long month of steak dinners). Chicken was phenomenal and honestly both my wife and I enjoyed that more than the steak. Brownie for desert was the perfect ending. Would definitely come back again.
reviews.author: Mark M.

reviews.text: Such an amazing experience! Came for drinks & appetizers and Wolf did not disappoint. Alicia was so attentive and made us feel extra special for our birthday celebration! Loved the ambiance and presentation of the food & drinks. Will definitely be back!
reviews.author: Tori P.

reviews.text: we came in for a birthday and alicia and she was so sweet. She came in with great recommendations on drinks, the punptini was a hit. She surprised the birthday girl with a dessert. She made the party and the birthday girl feel so seen and loved!! hands down the best service we got
reviews.author: Haley P.

reviews.text: Everything was great! Food and drinks were delicious and our server Barret was wonderful! We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Alison B.

reviews.text: First time at Wolf and it was wonderful! Barret and all the other staff members were absolutely wonderful and attentive! The food and drinks were delicious and the view from the 7th floor was spectacular! Would definitely dine here again
reviews.author: Jessica S.

reviews.text: We came in just for drinks and goat cheese balls and it did not disappoint! We loved the decor, excellent service and just a really fun experience. I can't wait to come back for dinner!
reviews.author: Megan G.

reviews.text: Located in the hotel next to a rooftop pool thought that was an interesting location. Many options for drinks that can get a little pricy. The small plates were very good the lobster crips are a must try, along with the shrimp cocktail. The hush puppies were lacking flavor but had lots of crab meat in them; the sauce that came with them is a water down sour cream and didn't complement the app well. Best truffle fries I have ever had! The wagyu sliders were nothing special for the price point. Our server was great! Allowed us to stay far beyond the 1.5 hour table limit. Careful to check your bill they charge a "venue fee" but never explain what it was or why it was there.
reviews.author: Amber E.

reviews.text: there were seven of us, and Anna handled everything with a friendly, professional manner. the view from the roof deck was wonderful, and the food delicious
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: ANNA!! she was amazing!! Emmy also help us along the way!!! We loved the bread and the cocktails!!!
reviews.author: Aaliyah W.

reviews.text:
Very loud restaurant with continuous fast beat music playing like a night club but the large wing backed chairs makes it easy to hear others at your table. 
Tables are a good distance apart.
Good size portions for the Fish and Chips.
Our server, Nicki, didn't rush us at all and allowed us to enjoy the stunning decor and atmosphere. 
Our Fish and Chips was very good.
Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Christa R.

reviews.text: As a former server, i know great service and a wonderful ambiance. Nicole C was the best server i have ever had. She was attentive, funny, and relatable. The entire dinner felt like an experience and we were more than taken care of by Nicole.
reviews.author: Zoey M.

reviews.text:
SHOUT OUT TO RICHARD, 
Not only was he a mixologist, his personality was beyond Warn and WelcoMing. Gave the best recommendations. Loved the experience. Will be back soon.
reviews.author: Rasheedah B.

reviews.text:
When in Arizona, must try 
Wolf by Vanderpump. It's Amazing! 
From the decor, view, pool, service, and menu.
I didn't expect to check all of my boxes. It is surprisingly Amazing!! Great place for crafted drink and great food. 
The ambiance is Classy Las Vegas theme with a pronounced Mountain View!! 
It's lovely, fox fur wing chairs, chrome square one of a kind chandeliers, Gothic railing , vintage bitters, liquors are organized by types,.. I can go on and on. 

See pictures is my advise...
reviews.author: Camille G.

reviews.text: We went there this last weekend to celebrate a friends birthday and it was awesome! Easy to make reservations and over all, quick service. The goat cheese balls, break appetizer and the shrimp cocktail were AMAZING. my husband and I shared the salmon and the risotto and also delicious. I highly recommend if ever in the area!
reviews.author: meaghan r.

reviews.text:
Can't speak on the menu or cuisine since we only went for drinks, but the vibe alone makes it worth a visit. Parking is difficult, and the valet is extremely slow, so plan for that.
Once inside, the space is very original, with a great vibe and breathtaking views that really set the mood. Our drinks took a while to arrive, but the cocktails were excellent and absolutely worth the wait.
reviews.author: Homeyra K.

reviews.text: Came tonight to check it out. The vibes and decor were a 10/10. It was such a great ambiance and the music was incredible. The food was good but nothing extravagant for expensive dishes. Theres amazing food all nearby for the same of less of a price. Our server was great and attentive but the bill took a while to come. Overall great time and happy I checked this place out!
reviews.author: Nayla G.

reviews.text:
Great atmosphere and cocktails,  but leaves more to be desired. 

Pros - attention to detail in the design and decor is second to none. We've been to other Vanderpump restaurants and this is right on par. Vibes high, dark, sexy, really good cocktails. DJ on Friday was solid. 10/10 would come back to sit at the bar and relax

Cons - food was average at best. Uninspired. Nothing you couldn't get anywhere else at half the price. On that note, pricing. Very expensive overall. We live and eat our way through Scottsdale and had some sticker shock. Expect $50+ entrees and $24+ cocktails. I'm all for paying for quality, but this just wasn't it. 

Come for the beautiful people, immaculate vibes, and thoughtful drinks. Miss the dinner plans.
reviews.author: Nicholas M.

reviews.text: The ambiance was really nice, the interior designer gets an A+. The service was also great, server was very attentive and friendly. The food was good, not as delicious as I was expecting because of the price, but overall it was still good.
reviews.author: Elliot S.

reviews.text: We came here for lunch during my bachelorette trip in the area! The restaurant is on the second floor of the hotel. It has beautiful decor and many picturesque opportunities. I was with a large group (11 people) and they let us know when we made our reservation that they do not have seating that fits that large of a party, so we would have to split up. Luckily they worked with us when we arrived to accommodate us at one large table so we could stay together! The food and drinks were good, but a little over priced. Our server was extremely kind and took great care of us!
reviews.author: Rachel B.

reviews.text:
Was able to enjoy a beautiful lunch with my best friend here at Wolf. The atmosphere is absolutely stunning with beautiful views of Camelback Mountain. The atmosphere of the restaurant is breathtaking.

Their food, unbelievable. Everything on the menu looked amazing.

We try to slew of their appetizers and I can't express to you how wonderful the food is. Our server was amazing though I forgot her name. She made dining here, Extremely fun.
reviews.author: Jenifer R.

reviews.text:
Wolf is on the 7th floor of the hotel and was visually a cool spot. The decor certainly felt a bit upscale but the dress code was all over the place from what I saw. 

The food was pretty good though some of my truffle fries were really oily as in dripping oil when you bit into them. But, the truffle flavor wasn't overpowering and the fries were crispy. The Wolf Burger had juicy patties and the melted havarti cheese definitely added to the flavor. I just don't think it wowed me to want to go back for it. I did enjoy my Desert Wolf shot. My friends enjoyed their drinks too: Sheep's Clothing which just looked visually stunning and their Cowboy Up. If you're an old fashioned kind of person, she enjoyed hers. 

Our waitress was super friendly and attentive. But, the music was so loud sitting near the deejay that we could barely hear each other. I wouldn't recommend coming here if you're looking to have a conversation over your meal.
reviews.author: Christine N.

reviews.text: After our initial experience and review, the GM Steve reached out immediately and asked us to come back to make up for it. We went back tonight and had a 180 experience. Our server, Sarah, was phenomenal and was extremely attentive. Our water and drinks were always filled and our food was all served at once, hot, and delicious. Steve came by our table several times to ensure we were happy, and it more than made up for our lackluster experience the first time. The entire staff was on top of things, and it seems Steve has really turned the restaurant around. The environment was perfect and I will now definitely recommend this restaurant to others.
reviews.author: Robbie W.

reviews.text:
While I'm a fan of Lisa Vanderpump and was excited to try this place out, I honestly had bit of low expectation due to some reviews not having a good experience coupled up with the fact that it's a celebrity owned place. However, I was pleasantly surprised by the ambience of the place as well as the food and drinks. 

To be fair, the only high expectations I had were for the cocktails -- gotta live up to the name and hype of Vanderpump Rules right? (If you know, you know) The cocktails were delish! I went with 4 other ladies and we just loooooved every drink we ordered -- which was probably a total of 8 different drinks. 

Loved the bread and goat cheese balls. Steak was actually very good quality; however -- they don't know how to cook it like a true high quality steak house would so don't expect any of that there. The bolognese was interesting, but ultimately wasn't a fan of it. I don't like brisket in bolognese type of thing; although it seemed to be a hit with some of the other girls. 

I give it 5 stars for the ambiance, drinks and apps. I'd definitely come back just for all three. Beautiful views as well, great spot for a date night. The vibe is sexy bougie, yet people aren't too dressy in this place. Perfect for Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Pamela G.

reviews.text:
Do not go to this restaurant. My daughter and I got food poisoning from the goat cheese balls.   The food was subpar and the service was awful. Do not waste your money.  

HORRIBLE !!
reviews.author: Debra F.

reviews.text: A fun experience.  Really great food and excellent service.  The decor totally unique.  A true Vanderpump design.
reviews.author: Steve D.

reviews.text: The staff was extremely attentive throughout our meal, and Barrett was a great waiter! Really enjoyed the emerald bay mocktail he recommended.
reviews.author: Kaitlyn C.

reviews.text: Big Vanderpump fan here, so Wolf has been on my "To Try" list for ages. We came here for a friend's birthday dinner, and this spot was perfect for the outing. This restaurant is located on the seventh floor of Caesars Republic Scottsdale. When you walk in, you are greeted by bold, dramatic design choices and full tables of patrons. If this is your first time at Wolf, you absolutely must try their Pumptini cocktail and their fried goat cheese balls! I highly recommend you put in a reservation, as this place gets busy. I ordered the Tuna Tartare Tostadas as my main dish to supplement my goat cheese balls and Pumptini. We had an excellent waitress who was very attentive to our party of 8, and the food arrived quite quickly. Other great dishes we loved on our visit were the Tricolor Risotto and Wolf Burger. There are a couple of vegetarian, free & gluten-free options on the menu, but those are mostly sides or salads. Great spot for a girls' night out!
reviews.author: Carly W.

reviews.text:
For our daughter's birthday celebration we wanted good food and excellent service, we got just that what an amazing experience! First our waiter Barret D was beyond outstanding!!  I am a Vanderpump Rules fan, the real reason we picked it, and loved his knowledge of not only the restaurant but the show!   We started with the Signature Wolf Bread that was fantastic, next we had the Famous Goat Cheese Balls and one of their mocktails, Berry S***.  For our meals we tried the Beurre Blanc Salmon, Colossal Shrimp Tacos and the Brisket & Tri-Tip Bolognese.  I must say out of all three dishes the Brisket & Tri-Tip Bolognese was outstanding, melt in your mouth delicious! 
Now, let's get to the couple of items that might be a deal breaker for some, they charge an additional 3.5% Venue Admin Fee on your final bill, I did not ask what it was for but for sure not a fan.  Secondly, most tables are outstanding and comfortable, however, as I pointed out in my photos a few tables have stools as chairs and sitting in them for an entire dinner service would be an issue for me and my husband so if your the same, and making reservations, you may want to mention you do not want these tables.  Thank you Barret for creating an extraordinary dinner experience for our family, we will be back!
reviews.author: Brandy S.

reviews.text:
My wife and I came to Wolf for birthday celebrations and this restaurant is special! The interior decor is very charming and intimate, and the vibes here are awesome. They had a live DJ on Saturday night to create a nice dinner atmosphere.

Our favorite highlights were the Wagyu sliders and Chilean seabass along with all of the signature cocktails. One important thing about this place is that you'll definitely need a reservation during the weekend given its popularity so be sure to book atleast 1-2 weeks in advance if you want a good time.

Overall, this is a wonderful date spot in Scottsdale if you're trying to impress your date and want to dress up!
reviews.author: Ashkan A.

reviews.text: The service was so speedy! Came in for lunch on a whim and left full and happy. Courtney was our server and she was very knowledgeable on the menu and recommended the farmers wrap, it was delicious! The bread was so yummy too. Would definitely make the drive to come back.
reviews.author: Lilly G.

reviews.text:
Staff:  Amazing, responsive, friendly
Food:  Perfect.  Not a single bad dish.  Steaks were cooked exactly as desired.  Food was delicious.
Decor/Env:  fun, high-end, classy, extravagantly stylish

Loved everything about this restaurant.
So why only 4 stars.   

The music.  It was great songs but it was sooooo loud!!   We felt like we were at the club right in front of the DJ.
Everyone was yelling to talk over the music.  Apart from that we loved the place.  Will be returning.
reviews.author: Stephen F.

reviews.text:
We came here for our anniversary! We had a really good time. We started with the famous cheese balls, they were pretty good, I'd definitely order them again. For dinner I got the shrimp tacos and my wife got the risotto. I had heard great things from several of our friends who had been there. It was really good but I was more impressed with their staff. They didn't hover but were attentive. The thing that I always enjoy is it actually seamed like the staff enjoyed working there! 

That's what will get me to comeback!
reviews.author: Brad F.

reviews.text:
Wolf is beautiful, it's very chic with fantastic views. A group of us sat at one of the large round tables with a rotating chandelier. It's was a very comfortable corner. 

Service was great and all of our food and beverages were delicious! 

For our appetizers we ordered the goat cheese-cheese balls, the tuna tartare tostada and the lump crab corn hush puppies. The tuna tartare tostada was my favorite, so fresh and flavorful. 

For my entree I had the 6oz prime filet mignon, Cooked to perfection and so tender. 

The drinks are all so beautiful, picture perfect. 
My drink, the Peter rabbit had the cutest little carrot, adorable.
reviews.author: Olivia R.

reviews.text: Wolf is one of the most stylish restaurants and lounges in Scottsdale with the best sunset views from the Caesars Republic Hotel's 7th floor.  Of course you expect creative cocktails; however, the food was also amazing.  The prices were upscale; however, reasonable considering the renovated decor, great service and location.
reviews.author: Ren H.

reviews.text: My opinion is that this place It is a bunch of hype riding on the coat tails of the Vanderpump Rules TV show. Beautiful ambiance but that was about it.  $65 for a glass of champagne was absurd!!!!  But I like Champagne so I ordered it and just  wanted to relax and enjoy the evening.  We ordered our drinks which took 20 minutes to arrive.   We started with an array of appetizers and it took an hour for them to arrive.  None of the appetizers were remarkable, and were pretty mediocre and definitely not worth that type of wait. An hour and a half later my husbands brick chicken arrived and we sent it back.  We lost our appetite by then.  The only thing i liked was the mac and cheese.  That was very good.  The caviar and chips would have been good as the chips were well made but the very SKIMPY plate of sour cream and caviar was a joke.  No one liked the lobster cervice tacos.  The sliders were just ok.  The goat cheese balls were good but the hot honey and sauce for it was a tiny dab on the plate for 4 large cheese balls.  It was almost like why bother, because there wasn't enough to make a difference.  The waitress took our order and disappeared and never checked in with us why our orders were taking so long.  I finally got up and found a bus boy and asked him to bring our server over and what looked like a manager came over and I told him how ridiculously long our order was taking and our food finally came but he made no attempt to make it up to us or apologize.  Pretty much he just came up to our table just to say he did.  Because I don't know what other purpose it served.  If you like to pay $65 for a glass of champagne, have an absentee server,  and wait until eternity to get your food, then you might like it as the ambiance is very nice.  We won't go back.  I really wanted to love it.  It was a real disappointment and I got the impression that that was what you need to expect when you dine My opthere.
reviews.author: T K.

reviews.text: Beautiful on the inside. Food is meh. I feel that way about every LVP restaurant; I have been to multiple locations: the original one in LA and also in Las Vegas and I am never impressed with the food. The cocktails are always great though. Cheers.
reviews.author: M G.

reviews.text:
Looks like they remodeled since I last visited.
Inside seating available or pick up and take to go! 
I like how clean it was inside and updated. 
Staff was friendly and helped us right away.
Sandwiches are always great, my favorite Italian bmt. Also more affordable.
reviews.author: brittini a.

reviews.text: Finally had dinner at Wolf by Vanderpump. The ambience is definitely a vibe. A lot of things to purchase as well if you're into collecting. There are 2 bar areas and ample seating. Definitely doesn't feel like a date night when hotel guests come to dinner in their pajamas but still fun. I will say for us the best dish were the the goat cheese balls from the appetizer list. They are fried and served with a sweet sauce on the side. They were a 4 out of 5 only because they were dry and hard to get the sauce on them. I ordered an athletic light because I don't drink and drive and it was very crisp!! I had a spring salad. It said it came with avocado but there wasn't any and the waitress sent it back but I still received it without the avocado so it was just a leafy green salad with very long slices of cucumber and tomato. It was a 1 out of 1. For dessert I had the brownie and ice cream and that was a 5 out of 5. If I ever went back, I'd go for a cocktail, maybe the cheeseboard and a different app and dessert. It's just one of those places that you can say, ya I've been there. The "Venue Admin Fee" of 3.50% is ridiculous and of course no one tells you about it.
reviews.author: Krista H.

reviews.text:
We made reservations to celebrate our anniversary on a Saturday night. 

We were greeted by the 3 or 4 hostesses at the hostess stand who were all very sweet and full of smiles. We arrived about 30 minutes early to grab a drink so went to the bar.  

Unfortunately half of the restaurant was closed off for a private event which meant the 2nd bar was closed off as well.  Sadly no seats at the bar but 2 seats they said were reserved.  By the way, we noticed they were still reserved and empty when we walked out two hours later so that was a little disappointing. 

We went back to the hostess stand who were able to seat us right away. 

My first dining experience at Wolf was quite an evening. Everyone in the restaurant was dressed to kill.  Glamours, stunning, excited to be there.  This evening felt off like everyone was just coming off the golf course. Super casual for such a beautiful restaurant.  There were actually two men at the bar wearing swim trunks.  IMHO, the restaurant is just so beautiful, I was surprised at how casual most people dressed. 

I didn't catch our servers name but she was nice and attentive. For drinks we ordered two dirty martinis. They were served correctly and ice cold.

For our appetizer, we ordered the HEIRLOOM BEETS $16. Heirloom & Striped Beets, Pistachios, Lemon & Herb Pesto, Baby Arugula, Burrata.  This was refreshing and delicious.  Large enough for your people to share.

For dinner, I ordered the 6oz PRIME FILET MIGNON. $59. Cognac Butter, Parsnip Purée, Seasonal Vegetables, Cabernet Demi Glace, Roasted Red Onion Petals, Potatoes Anna. This was delicious.  Filet cooked perfect medium.

My husband ordered the BUTTER SEARED CHILEAN SEABASS. $59. 
Sauce Vierge with Capers, Lemon Butter, Baby Cherry Tomato, Black Olives, Potatoes Anna, Seasonal Vegetables.  He loved it and said it was super flavorful.  Loved the potatoes. 

As it was our anniversary they offered us a dessert but we were too full to accept.  Very nice of the restaurant. 

Overall we really enjoyed our dinner and evening. Although there were a few unexpected occurrences, they didn't spoil our night. 

We will be back.
reviews.author: Holly M.

reviews.text: Very weird vibes coming in. Honestly felt like I was in a mirror dimension which put me a bit on edge. Had a reservation and still had to wait an additional 30+ minutes for a table. The chair situation at some of the tables is odd. Why was I sitting on an ottoman? Very uncomfortable. Because of the overall experience in the beginning we just decided to get drinks and goat cheese balls instead of ordering dinner. Our server was super nice and saved the experience for a bit until the drinks came out... we ordered the espresso martini and it tasted like straight vodka (even the manager said the drink color was off). Goat cheese balls were alright, not as yummy as other Vanderpump restaurants I've been to. Management was great and very understanding about our over all experience being bad and helped us out with the bill. Unfortunately we will not be returning.
reviews.author: Eve W.

reviews.text: It was a beautiful atmosphere - drinks were amazing!I highly recommend the pumptini and the vanderpump mule will attach pics of the mule an lambrusco spritz!
reviews.author: Victoria F.

reviews.text: Barret was amazing!! We had such a great birthday dinner for our friend. Food/atmosphere was 10/10
reviews.author: Teagan T.

reviews.text: Barret was amazing!! Food and drinks were delightful, such a fun vibe. Lisa give that man a promotion!
reviews.author: Izzy E.

reviews.text: Amazing service! Jax (not to be confused with the og )the servers assistant was amazing and very attentive! Our server Berrett was amazing as well with awesome recommendations!! Made my birthday visit amazing and loved that the manger Steven even messed with us and heard us out!! Great experience always love a LVP night
reviews.author: Lexi S.

reviews.text: Wow what a beautiful restaurant! Such fun drinks and appetizers! Highly recommend the pumped up kicks martini, the signature bread and the wagyu sliders with fries.
reviews.author: Debbie C.

reviews.text: Went here for my birthday dinner and it met and exceeded all my expectations. We were sat in a gorgeous corner booth and welcomed with a welcome shot. I ordered the Dirty Dog Martini which is perfect for savory girls. As an appetizer we got the world famous goat cheese balls which were worth the hype. For an entree I got the Brisket and Tri Tip Bolognese which was amazing. My friend also got the garden green salad which was to die for. An amazing experience. Our server was also the best ever.
reviews.author: Paige A.

reviews.text:
Update!

I received a response on here from Jennifer.  Called the number provided and no one answered. And left a message 

Mother's Day Disappointment !  

I made reservations over a month ago for my family 7 adults and 2 babies. Then 2 weeks ago I added two more adults.  It took 4 calls during business hours for someone to actually answer. I left messages and also sent an email with no response. If you have 5 girls standing around one should be answering the phones. Or at least the hotel operator.  

Our reservation was for 1pm.  We finally were sat at 155pm. With this we were sat prior in a lounge and given some champagne and then left with no one coming back with orange juice. The hostess said it was policy not to sit anyone until the entire party was here we had everyone present at 110pm. When pressed she said the table wasn't  ready. She flat out lied to my face. Not impressive ! 

Once sat, we ordered all the appetizers on the menu.  So we could at least get some food quickly - so we thought which did not happen for 45 minutes.  

No apologies were given now that we are 2 hours into something we thought was a Michelin chef! The meal shows up another 45 minutes later. The meal that was served was not good(awful) I would hope she(Vanderplump) would take her name of this restaurant and or the hotel would take responsibility for an awful experience and a sub par meal !
reviews.author: Jackie D.

reviews.text:
Update: We called the number Jennifer the business manager provided in her reply to my review. No answer and left a voicemail, we will see if they ever call back. Please note, this is the same number we called multiple times to get our reservation set up and changed. Extremely hard to get ahold of someone. Some 5 start experience they provide 

Let's paint a picture...It's Mother's Day and you spend the day waiting for lunch at Wolf by Vanderpump. 11 adults and 2 kids. Reservation at 1pm, 75% of the party has arrived, they state, we can't sit you until the full party arrived. 1:15pm, full party arrived, table not ready. 
1:20pm, they tell us it'll be a little bit until table it ready, they tell us they will sit in the lounge with a couple comped champagne bottles. 1:45pm, they take us to our table outside in the 105° weather (luckily with shade and misters). We order everything as soon as we can, the waits continue with appetizers and mains. Set menus and they still couldn't produce highly quality foods and service. Appetizers ,they were good. Entree's, not so much. We sent prime rib back because they decided to prepare and cut meats and let sit until heat lamps for probably 10+ minutes. I'd rather have my prime rib cut and served at Golden Corral. Pictures included. 
$900 spent, even with 20% off after everything. 
First and last time time we will be there. And will not recommend to other family or friends. 
They also have a 3.5% admin service fee they charge everyone to use a credit card. They obviously hate their customers that much to not eat the cost of that. 
I get everyone's experience is different, but this was ours on a special day.
reviews.author: Sheyenne D.

reviews.text:
Brunch
Went for my Mother's Day today. Service was slow. Never brought a beer to my husband. Didn't bring salt/pepper. Every food item was bad. An actual anchovie in my salad ( I hate fish) . The steak salads came out ice cold like frozen in the middle and literally not cooked. Breakfast potato's were as hard as croutons. The drinks were good. Manager comped the food but to place an automatic 20% tip on the full order when it was horrible and service was horrible. Came home to eat a burrito i made last night. Just crazy suppose to be fine dining but oreganos would have been better. Extremely disappointed and we won't be back.
reviews.author: Debbie A.

reviews.text: Delicious drinks and great views. Love what they did with the remodel. Great spot for date night drinks or a girls night out.
reviews.author: Jordan H.

reviews.text:
We celebrated my birthday dinner at Vanderpump's Wolf with a group of friends, such a fun night!  It was our whole group's first time visiting. We arrived about 45 minutes early to grab a drink at the hotel rooftop bar.  They had a live band and the views of Camelback were stunning. We were there just before sunset, and the sky turned the prettiest shades of pink, such a perfect start to the evening.

When we headed down for our reservation, we were seated right away. The decor immediately stood out. Antler chandeliers mixed with furs and crystals, oversized chairs, and wolf statues created this unique blend of elegance and rustic charm. The whole space feels like a rustic bougie dream. The bar itself is incredibly long and cool. 

Our group sat at a great round table with a mix of booth seating and chairs, which made it feel social and comfortable. We staged with cocktails, and they were just as fun as they were delicious. The Pumped Up Kicks espresso martini came with a wolf  chocolate and a donut hole. The Petter Rabbit garden margarita was another standout, complete with the tiniest carrot I have ever seen, so cute! 

For appetizers, we ordered the lump crab and corn hush puppies, the famous goat cheese balls, and the tuna tartare tostadas. Everything was excellent, but the tuna tartare tostadas were my favorite. They were incredibly fresh and the poke sauce really good. The goat cheese balls and hush puppies were such a hit with the group that we ended up ordering another round of each for the table. 

For my entrée, I had the butter seared Chilean seabass, which was cooked perfectly. It came with cherry tomatoes, lemon, olives, and capers, along with light vegetables and potatoes that balanced the dish really well. Others at the table ordered the brisket and tri tip bolognese, the 6oz prime filet mignon with roasted red onion petals and potatoes Anna, and the tricolore risotto. Everyone enjoyed their meals overall, although the risotto was surprisingly very spicy, which caught us off guard. We also added a side of truffle fries, which were definitely worth it.

For dessert, we shared the house made chocolate brownie, a perfect sweet ending to the meal.  They brought it with a candle to sing Happy Birthday.  The service was great throughout the night, and we never felt rushed, which made it easy to relax and enjoy the evening. Between the atmosphere, the creative cocktails, and the delicious food, it was such a fun experience. We will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Laura M.

reviews.text:
LVP youv done it again ! 
Such a dashing & luxe textured establishment... I expected nothing less from miss Lisa. 
Weak portions, most definitely was suprised by this, but the flavor profile itself were unique & at variety. I'm looking forward to returning for dinner service. Francesco behind the bar was simply phenomenal & a stand out in an already stunning experience. This is where you bring the ladies for a night out for Pumptinis & pics. Very charming. 
Thank you Wolf. Xx
reviews.author: Alexa M.

reviews.text: very excellent service.  everyone was so attentive.  Delicious food excellent drinks.
reviews.author: Ramneet C.

reviews.text: Emmy and Jacob were exceptional at hosting us! The food was great and they were so welcoming and kind.
reviews.author: Mrigakshi D.

reviews.text: The service and ambiance were great, however the food wasn't amazing. I felt it was overpriced for what I got. I ordered a salad which was supposed to have avocado, and got 2 dime sized pieces. All of our other food was just okay.
reviews.author: Alyssa F.

reviews.text:
I really wanted to love WOLF by Vanderpump, but unfortunately it fell short--especially for the price point.

When you're spending this kind of money on a meal, you expect near perfection, and this just wasn't it. The goat cheese balls were okay, but definitely not worthy of being called "famous." The drinks, I will say, were the highlight--beautiful presentation and genuinely delicious. But that's where the excitement ended.

The food itself was underwhelming. The chicken was completely smothered in sauce, to the point where you couldn't really enjoy the dish. The truffle fries had no truffle flavor at all, which was disappointing. The Chilean sea bass tasted good, not great, but the presentation was honestly pretty unappealing. And the stone fruit cobbler? Completely lacking in flavor.

Our bill, with tip, came out to over $500, for 4 people which made the experience even harder to justify. For that price, I expect an exceptional meal from start to finish--and Scottsdale has plenty of places that deliver exactly that.

Honestly, I've had far better meals for much less.

With so many amazing restaurants in the area, I'd pass on this one.
reviews.author: Amy S.

reviews.text:
I took two of my girlfriends who were visiting from out of town to Wolf by Vanderpump back in January. They're both fans of the Vanderpump shows so they were excited to check it out. We arrived around 5 pm on a Saturday. We didn't have reservations, but we were able to grab a few seats at the bar.

Wolf by Vanderpump is on the 7th floor of Caesars Republic Scottsdale which offers stunning views of Camelback Mountain. The ambiance is sexy and upscale. The bartenders were friendly and greeted us as soon as got to the bar.

We ordered the following:
Salted caramel espresso martini $21
Pumptini $20
The famous goat cheese balls $17
Caviar and chips $45
Signature wolf bread $16

The drinks were fun and tasty. The salted caramel espresso martini was definitely more of a dessert, which I enjoyed. The goat cheese balls, caviar and chips, and wolf bread were all delicious. The caviar & chips only came with 1/2 oz caviar, which isn't much especially to share, so keep that in mind if you order that.

Reservations are highly recommended. Visit during sunset!
reviews.author: Gretel Y.

reviews.text: was so excited to try this place as i'm a huge lisa vanderpump fan. my fiance & i walked up to the host stand (3 girls) & they starred at us like we were crazy for interrupting their conversation lol. we asked if we needed a reservation & they said yes even tho the bar/tables was empty.. being in the industry myself im actually surprised on how rude they were. my fiance then said we should make a reservation for a future time & they said nothing & kept on with their conversation so we awkwardly walked away. really uncomfortable experience & we didn't even enter the restaurant yet.
reviews.author: Hay G.

reviews.text:
My first experience was with friends at a table and it was nice.  It's a beautiful restaurant indeed.

I was excited take my daughters here since they are big fans of the reality show.  Thought perhaps, we can celebrate my daughter's 30th.  

Stopped in at 3:30 to show my other daughter the restaurant, and wow horrible experience.

Hostesses were very busy chatting with each instead of welcoming us in.  We sat ourselves at the bar closest to entrance .  

I didn't realize how long the bar was cuz it's separated by mirrored walls.  Good/bad..,makes it hard for staff to see the customers??

We didn't see any staff so we went to the center bar where there were 4 ppl with drinks.  A staff not in uniform comes directly in front of us doing something.  She didn't acknowledge us at all!!!   No "hello, someone will be with you".  She did her thing and left.  

3 of 4 ppl left and still crickets.  I mean no other customer except the one guy with a laptop at the end of the bar.  

Finally , a bartender shows up.  Not the friendliest greeting, just a matter of fact.  We got drinks & app but had to request small plates from the  bar back, Seth.  Seth was actually the friendliest staff there.  

I'm so glad we are NOT celebrating our daughter's birthday there.  I don't care how beautiful the place is.  Why would anyone want to go pay for bad service??!!!   

Train your ppl to actually be kind, welcoming and provide good service.

Highly do NOT recommend.  There's too many good restaurants with good service to choose from here.
reviews.author: Pie G.

reviews.text:
I was fully prepared to be disappointed in all of the food after reading the reviews but I ended up being pleasantly surprised! We had to get the famous goat cheese balls with hatch chile and hot honey of course. These were pretty good! Not sure what makes them famous but I liked the creamy mix of goat cheese with the spicy hot honey. We paired these with the tuna tartare tostadas which were so unexpectedly delicious and fresh for being in Scottsdale! Would absolutely get these again. We also shared the Caesar salad. This was good but I didn't love the whole anchovies.

Service was excellent. We let the waitress know we were in a bit of a hurry and she got us our food, drinks, and the bill in under 40 minutes. Amazing! Honestly, it was pretty expensive so I can see being underwhelmed if you got some of the mains but I think it's a great spot for happy hour or just drinks and light bites.

I was also pretty surprised to learn they are not dog friendly! Given Lisa's animal activism and love for her own dog (there's even portraits of him in the restaurant), I was really surprised the don't allow furry companions.
reviews.author: Brittany T.

reviews.text: Ate tonight. Poor service. 20 minute gap in service. And when we expressed our frustration the waiter made it worse instead of deescalating. paid 177 for a seabass shrimp taco, caviar and chips and 2 glasses of wine.
reviews.author: John M.

reviews.text: This place has a wonderful view with great style. The staff are all very helpful and sweet. The food was very good. We had a few things that were fabulous and few things just mediocre. The Bolognese and the Seabass were phenomenal. The goat cheese balls were quite tasty. The bread from the appetizer menu should just be bread given to the table. It's not much to write home about and the filet mignon was just mediocre.
reviews.author: Lindsey S.

reviews.text:
Wolf is a beautiful space with a lovely team. I'm obsessed about the Campari Tomato salad and my sea bass (off menu prepared with simple butter lemon - not the menu recipe) was divine.

However our table reservation was 30 minutes late. Multiple check in with the front desk finally led to them offering us a glass of bubbles. But no other real accommodation. Then the service remained sluggish with multiple requests for water, wine and even clearing of dirty plates.  

These details are critical to gaining repeat customers.  Happy to chat with management if they would like!
reviews.author: Ann T.

reviews.text: Celebrated a birthday and we had fish and chips.  Fantastic beer battered, served w/peas and crispy fries.  Fresh ingredients, Overall the best ever!
reviews.author: Helen K.

reviews.text:
I've been dying to go to a LVP restaurant since Stassi and Jax were a thing.  When I had to go to Scottsdale for work, my friends surprised me with a (belated) birthday lunch at Wolf, and walking in, I was completely blow away.  The woman knows how to create *a vibe* and the ambiance is stunning.  It wasn't at all crowded on a Sunday afternoon just before 2, and we were expecting a lot.

Thinking back on the experience, I'm reminded of the scene from 10 Thing I Hate About You when Chastity says, "You can be overwhelmed or underwhelmed, but can you ever be just whelmed?" At first, I was over, then I was jut whelmed, and very quickly I was underwhelmed.

I ordered an Everything But The Bagel martini which somehow took like 20 minutes to make after everyone else got their drinks.  I guess I was expecting something great? It was just the seasoning in my regular martini.  My friend's cocktail was smoked and came out with the smoke dome, and that's always a really fun thing to see, but it was all show, no flavor. 

We got the famous goat cheese balls, and they were so bland and boring I cannot understand how they are famous. They were lukewarm and there was nothing but goat cheese in a crust.  I guess people have been raving about them for 20 years, so we were all expecting to be blown away - though these started in LA and perhaps no one eats there.  The pull-apart bread is not that, it's just....bread. The butters it comes with have things in them that you can't really taste.  I mean, it wasn't bad, but it wasn't worth the hype. 

I got the chicken Caesar wrap, and it was not at all impressive.  Food trucks have made better.  The lettuce was so lightly dressed it should have been "crispy chicken with (wilted) iceberg lettuce and once frozen fries."  Two of my dining companions got the beet salad, and the beets weren't cooked evenly.  One of them added shrimp for $12 and it was a SINGLE SHRIMP.  My 4th friend got the wings and shrimp cocktail, which were the best meals of the group.  That being said, she has a severe egg allergy and the servers were positive the bread and cheese balls didn't have egg, until we asked them to please ask the chef (they definitely have egg). 

They did bring out complementary dessert, which was vanilla gelato on a brownie and a cup of vanilla gelato for my allergy-ridden friend, and it was the most confusing part of the entire experience.  It was under no circumstances "gelato" and it tasted like something and nothing at all.  It was like one of those airy nothing artificially flavored Tasty D'Lites from the early 2000s.  It was also not vanilla - it tasted like caramel lemon something?  I dunno, it was a lovely gesture but it was also just so odd that we didn't eat it. 

The whole lunch took almost two hours - no water refills, the server didn't come by that much, and it was just not a place to go if you had things to do and places to be.  I'm glad I went, I'm glad I have tried everything so I can have a first-hand opinion, but I'm not clamoring to go back.
reviews.author: Jenna D.

reviews.text: Generous portion of the famous goat cheese balls, though a smidge bland. Signature wolf bread is tasty and the accoutrements were appreciated. Shrimp tacos... shrimp nicely fried but the undercooked tortilla really didn't do it for me. Strong cocktails, great service. LVP ambience which I kinda adore.
reviews.author: Brian P.

reviews.text:
Attention Vanderpump Fans! We were so excited to try Wolf in Scottsdale located on the 7th floor of Caesars Republic Scottsdale for my 52nd birthday and Easter weekend. We made reservations ahead of time for an early dinner on this perfect April Arizona day and passed hotel guests lounging at the pool area attached to the restaurant. Service was really great here and I was treated extra special as bday girl and offered either complimentary birthday shots for the table or a birthday dessert to share (if I chose to). 
I really enjoyed the exquisite decor of neutrals, metallics, bling, fur covered textiles, & wild predatory beasts! Let's not forget portraits of Giggy and of Lisa displayed throughout. 
Of course we ordered the Famous Goat Cheese Balls with delicious Hatch Chile Hot Honey. We tried the Chilean Seabass, Ken's Haddock 'n' Chips, Tricolore Risotto for dinner and sampled cocktails before enjoying the brownie and ice cream dessert topped with a Wolf chocolate square. What a great experience and evening!
reviews.author: Stephanie V.

reviews.text:
This place is an absolutely incredible experience! The restaurants is within Caesars, and the decor, design, and ambiance to this place is extremely unique, elegant, and enjoyable. 

Staff here seems to be very knowledgeable about the menu, very friendly and helpful in providing menu suggestions when guests are unsure of what to order, and they take wonderful care of their guests. We were frequently checked on, water and drink refills were never too long, and they did a wonderful job of helping to celebrate my wife's birthday.

For an appetizer we ordered their bread service. The bread came with two different flavored butters that could be enjoyed, both of which were fantastic. It also had some crispy, melted cheese that added a great crunch and flavor above and beyond what would've been expected. For dinner, I had their Wolf Burger, which came with 8oz of wagyu beef (2 patties), onions, and their delicious house aioli. Easily one of the better burgers I've had in recent years in the Old Town Scottsdale area.

This place is a must try if you're looking for something unique, or a venue for a special occasion such as a birthday, anniversary, or any other celebration.
reviews.author: Joe R.

reviews.text: Very disappointed with this location after having been to other Vanderpump locations. We had made a reservation so didn't have to wait long. Once we got seated the chairs that they had us at were stained and didn't look the cleanest. Once the staff came over and was going over the menu with us. She said the wine is no better than Costco brand and that it wasn't very good. We informed them that we had dinner reservations in 1.5 hour. We had one round of drinks and went to place another order and they only took half of the groups order. Once we got their attention again and placed the other drink orders we had about 45minutes before we needed to leave. Those 45 minutes had passed and we had no drinks or check. We proceeded to stand up to get someone's attention since we needed to leave and they brought the drinks over and we asked for the check right away. They were able to get us the check quick so we could leave but the service overall was very slow. The drinks were good but the service could definitely use some improvement.
reviews.author: Jared E.

reviews.text:
First, last and only time I will visit! Went for lunch around 11:30am on a weekday. We made reservations in advance and upon our arrival, we were put at a giant fire table outside and never offered an option to dine inside, which was kind of the point of going...the atmosphere. Also worth noting, when we arrived, there were no other customers. 
Service was slow from start, which was surprising considering there were no other customers. We finally placed our order. I ordered the Caesar Salad w/Shrimp (cheese & dressing on the side). After what felt like an exceptionally long time, our food arrived and much to my disappointment the greens had started to turn that reddish/brown on the ends indicating they were not fresh and I had ONE overcooked shrimp!!! For an extra $14, I had one shrimp!!! I asked the server who was assisting if that was intentional. He said he would check with the kitchen and let me know. He disappeared and never returned. $31 for an old salad, dressing that came out of a jar and one shrimp....pathetic! We waited and waited for the check, server never asked if we needed anything or how our meal was (we all left half eaten entrees). She finally showed up after we sent the assistant server to find her because we were ready to go. They also charge a "venue fee" which is absurd. Waste of money on overpriced mediocre, bland food and abysmal service.
reviews.author: Tristan T.

reviews.text:
I heard about the goat cheese balls for years on Vanderpump Rules. I made all of our dinner reservations a month or so before our trip. While looking at different restaurants, I discovered I was going to be in a city where Lisa Vanderpump had a restaurant and I could get goat cheese balls! Clearly we had to go there!

The restaurant is on the seventh floor of the Caesars Republic Hilton Hotel in Scottsdale. We had a reservation and were greeted at the hostess stand right at the entrance to the restaurant. We were seated in a cozy corner and it was nice because there was so much to look at! I would have taken more photos but didn't want to disturb other diners. The whole place is a vibe - there's something to look at everywhere.

Our fabulous server, Coco, came over and introduced herself. We asked if she would take a photo of us before we got started (it was Easter - we ended a pic) and she was happy to do so. She took us outside and took it with the sun setting in the back. Loved it! I've included it with my other photos in this review.

Coco was very knowledgeable about the menu and that definitely helped us make our choices. We started with cocktails, the wonderful goat cheese balls, and a signature bread. We wouldn't get the bread again - it was kind of a nothing. But the goat cheese balls! The hype is real!

Our food, cocktails,service, the vibe - everything was on point and we can't wait to go again when we're in
reviews.author: Melanie B.

reviews.text:
We arrived around 9 pm, which is late but still well before their 12 am closing time, so expectations for service and food quality were still reasonable.

The experience quickly fell apart. It took 45 minutes for five small goat cheese balls to arrive, which were pretty good but not worth the long wait. They were also out of frozen drinks, so I ordered the "gold water" margarita, which ended up being 95% tequila and practically undrinkable for someone who's not an alcoholic. 

When the food finally came out, it was greasy, bland, and completely lacking flavor.

Only reason this gets 2 stars is because the atmosphere was good, but everything else was so bad.
reviews.author: Pat M.

reviews.text:
To be fair, our first and only experience was their Easter brunch buffet. For a restaurant that's only been open for four months to take on this holiday was brave. 

The restaurant itself is beautiful, elegant as expected. Great views, beautiful bar. Really top notch. 

The food was "buffet good." I'm not a huge fan of the serve-yourself experience, but for certain holidays buffet dining is the default option. By our 12:30 seating they had already begun to run out of some items. Not unusual. The carving station meats were well past their prime, with just the end cuts remaining. The dessert station was underwhelming, mostly breakfast danish. They ran out of macarons which we were all looking forward to. They seemed to have trouble keeping the sauces and condiments stocked, and could have used some sauce ramekins for serving. 
 
That aside, the food was really good. Shrimp the size of a baby's foot, plentiful crab legs, and crunchy but moist fried chicken were some of the favs. The omelette station was good, but the chef lacked a little finesse, turning out choppy but great tasting eggs. 

Overall, a good experience. It left us all anxious to return for a proper plated meal very soon
reviews.author: Patrick F.

reviews.text: We went for Easter brunch and had a great experience. The atmosphere was beautiful and perfect for the occasion, but the real standout was the service. Emily, our server, was fantastic! Attentive, friendly, and even made an off-menu drink from another Vanderpump restaurant. Such a great touch. Definitely recommend!
reviews.author: Andrea L.

reviews.text: Wolf by Vanderpump is the kind of place you go to when you want more than just dinner, you want an experience. Between the gorgeous setting, delicious drinks, and standout service (thank you again, Kelsey!), it's absolutely worth the visit.
reviews.author: Adriana R.

reviews.text: Kelsey was the absolute best. had such a great experience!! She was awesome. The food and drinks were amazing.
reviews.author: Corey

reviews.text: The entire staff is so amazing!! Amy, Emy, and Francesco gave such good service. Our experience was so good we never wanted to leave.!! I'll be back & recommending everyone to come experience this restaurant. 10/10
reviews.author: paige p.

reviews.text: I came in for the first time for my birthday and it was truly the best experience I could have ever had! My best friend and I got Amy and Emmy and they were the best duo ever!! They were so attentive and had the most incredible energy! Truly the best birthday! As a Vanderpump lover, this EXCEEDED my expectations!!
reviews.author: Mishaila B.

reviews.text:
Came in to see what all the rage was about this place. We got to the bar at 3:30 and ordered an espressos martini. BOY were we DISAPPOINTED! This drink "advertised"  looks completely different than what we received. And, the pour was about 3/4 full and certainly not the traditional espresso martini we're used to being served in Scottsdale! 
Lisa V- gotta do better!
reviews.author: Randall F.

reviews.text:
This place is incredibly overrated!  The experience begins by being greeted by a not so nice and incredibly dim young hostess who barely covers her body with the clothing she wears. 
The atmosphere of the restaurant is a definite WOW very cool decorations, eclectic seating and then comes a very disappointing slightly elevated pub menu. 
The bread is great, when served in a loaf, when sliced and toasted it's less of a feature. The flavored butters are excellent, but this is a dish you must order and pay for. 
The rest of the menu is just not much of a wow. I had good wings, disappointing sliders, weak salad and the portions are very tiny. 
The brownie sundae dessert, is really the only dessert and incredible but overall the servers are grumpy. Kindness is checked at the door and I think you are there for the atmosphere or to say you checked out Wolf. 
It was incredibly underwhelming and I am not sure I would return. 
I have gone twice so they got a second chance and sadly failed again. 
Worth seeing once for sure but maybe go for dessert.
reviews.author: Sara C.

reviews.text: Service was great! Kelsey was so personal and attentive! It was our first time at Wolf and we appreciated her suggestions and explanations! & thank you for the tip to go upstairs to enjoy that view! Thank you Kelsey! (from your favorite Midwest table!)
reviews.author: K M.

reviews.text:
As a surprise to commemorate the start of my 50th birthday month, yes I said month, one of my really good friends in Phoenix remembered that I mentioned how much I loved reality TV and Vanderpump and all its affiliates being one of them so...

Earlier in the week he suggested to me to be dressed on Sunday. "I'm coming to get you at 6p." Suffice it say, we drove and drove and drove and I  tried to figure out where he was taking me and I passed all of the usual staples on our way from downtown PHX, and was surprised that we came upon Wolf. 

I have been wanting to come here since the day it opened and I couldn't believe this is how I was starting off my birthday month. So, already the bar was set high and I was super excited to get inside to start. 

Decor is gorgeous! Classic Vanderpump look, very reminiscent of the many other Vanderpump restaurants as I've been to just about all of them and that means all over the world. This was gorgeous. The giant retracted window in one of the dining areas where you could look out into the sunset and the mountains was divine, but also the long bar, the seating, the different types of chairs, the chandeliers the decor was just beautiful... a wonderful combination of hard metals and soft fluffy furry animal skins (is the best way I can think to describe it). The lighting was gorgeous. It was just super sexy. 

My friend made a reservation to sit at a table, but I love sitting at a bar so to the bar we went as they found seats for us. 

Our bartender was super welcoming lovely and I love beautiful staff. I hate to say it, but I just love eating and staring at beautiful people so this was perfect. We were presented with menus which again were gorgeous. I went for my classic slightly dirty martini, my friend, he went for his classic espresso martini, and both drinks were made to perfection. We really didn't even need another one because this one really hit the spot but what the hell, we went for another one while we waited. 

We ordered the tuna tacos, which were unbelievable. My friend never eats raw fish and he's never had this before, but I made him and he ate it as a gift for my birthday, and we still cannot stop talking about how perfectly balanced these tuna tacos were.  I mean absolutely delicious. The little fried shells were so tender and soft. You could tell they were fresh. They weren't hard, which sometimes ruins the balance between chilled soft tuna, and what it's being held in. I mean, the accoutrements just settled in beautifully.  

Our entrées weren't anything exciting to talk about as they came both with the same side dishes, which in my opinion is a little bit lazy of a new chef and I'll blame that on growing pains, but I would think that at a restaurant of this stature, each protein/main dish would be curated with a beautiful specific side dish option with it, but they both had some sort of fanned out, baked potato slice fin-type decorative potato.  I don't know what you call it... and a vegetable. I had the sea bass and my friend, he had the filet mignon. They were both satisfactory meals. Nothing to write home about but good nonetheless, we ate it. 

The real Star here was the tuna appetizer, the service, the drinks and just the beautiful staff. Everyone was so kind to us. They even sent me a wonderful dessert for free. I'm assuming it was for free because they had forgot to tell us that the kitchen had closed so in all actuality, we weren't even supposed to receive the opportunity to order dessert, but as they did not advise us the kitchen had closed, they were able to muster up a dessert for my birthday and brought it out. And quite honestly, it was worth all the trouble to argue for - this thing was Dee-lush-US!! I won't even spoil the joy of what this dessert was, but here's what I will say...

The first chance you get you have to go here. It is an experience for the senses. I would have every person I know come by here, but most importantly, the tuna taco appetizer, the cocktails, and the dessert were to die for. The staff, gorgeous to look at and beautiful, and just so lovely to us. We had a fantastic time. 

We had great conversations with everyone that worked there and found the place to be beautiful. I cannot wait to go back and you should get there when you can as you will so appreciate what I've had to tell you.
reviews.author: Kymbre D.

reviews.text:
The vibe was cool
The service was awful .. it was like they threw a bunch of kids with bad attitudes on the floor and said fiquire it out .. horrible .. this was my second time there and same .. train your staff if you want people want come back!
Food was not bad but the whole experience was awful.
reviews.author: Lori F.

reviews.text:
The ambiance was beautiful and really set the tone for a great experience. The food was delicious, and our waitress was amazing,we absolutely loved her and the service she provided.
The only downside was the music. We went on a Saturday, and while we did enjoy the selection, the volume was way too loud for the setting. It made it difficult to have a conversation with the person next to you or even hear the waitress clearly.
Overall, everything else was amazing, but lowering the music volume would make the experience much more enjoyable.
reviews.author: Irene S.

reviews.text:
Just visited Wolf by Vanderpump in Scottsdale for a friend's birthday, and WOW--this place absolutely lives up to the hype. From the moment we walked in, the vibe was stunning and elevated, perfect for a night out with friends. The Vanderpumps definitely know how to decorate--this place is absolutely gorgeous.

I did make a reservation more than a month in advance for our group, but unfortunately a few friends had to cancel last minute. When we arrived, the hostess seemed a bit annoyed and didn't honor our original seating, instead moving us to a makeshift table that we didn't really fit around. That was honestly my only downside of the night.

Let's talk drinks first because they were next-level. I ordered the Sheep's Clothing Strawberry Jalapeño Sour, and I'm still thinking about that presentation--cotton candy and gold carrot flakes?! So creative and honestly delicious. I also tried the Snowbird (fresh coconut mojito), which was super refreshing and gave total "perfect poolside drink" energy. And of course, had to try the Pumptini--such a fun, classic Vanderpump staple.

For apps, we ordered the famous Goat Cheese Balls, and I totally get why everyone talks about them. The golden fried chèvre paired with the hatch chile hot honey and that Napa cabbage & pear slaw was such a good combo--sweet, savory, and a little spicy. My only tiny note: the cheese balls were pretty big, so the cheese-to-honey ratio felt a little off--there just wasn't quite enough sauce (and it was so good I wanted more of it!).

We kept it light with drinks and apps for the birthday celebration, and it was the perfect choice. And honestly, the ritzy people-watching was next-level entertainment all on its own.

Great atmosphere, amazing presentation, and everything we tried hit. Already planning my next visit!
reviews.author: Jessica B.

reviews.text:
Had high expectations for Wolf by Vanderpump, but the experience fell well short. We had a 6:30 reservation and still waited about 20 minutes to be seated, which was frustrating right from the start. Unfortunately, things didn't improve once we sat down--it took another 30 minutes just to get our drinks.

The food was average at best, nothing memorable or worth the hassle. What really stood out (in a bad way) was the service. It felt completely unorganized and poorly managed, like the staff had little to no training or support. To make matters worse, there was no sign of management anywhere to address issues or keep things running smoothly.

The final straw was when they tried to overcharge us by $10 on a bottle of wine. It was corrected, but it shouldn't have happened in the first place.

Overall, disappointing experience with poor service and lack of attention to detail. Not worth the price or the hype.
reviews.author: Scott H.

reviews.text: came in in for our anniversary! Nicole C was amazing! she took such good care of us. definitely coming back soon!
reviews.author: Stormi B.

reviews.text:
I visited WOLF by Vanderpump during a trip to Scottsdale, and wow--what an experience. Located on the 7th floor of Caesars Republic Scottsdale, the vibe alone is worth the visit--trendy, energetic, and just the right amount of upscale.

Let's talk food... the fish was absolutely colossal (and delicious), and the fries were perfectly crispy. The Bloody Mary? So good I basically chugged it without shame. My husband ordered the burger with truffle fries, and both were exactly what you hope for--flavorful, indulgent, and totally satisfying.

And the real star? The cheese balls. I would order those again and again and again--seriously, they're that good.

Pricing felt pretty average for the area, especially considering the atmosphere and overall experience. If you're looking for great food, fun vibes, and a memorable spot in Scottsdale, this place definitely delivers.
reviews.author: Casandra R.

reviews.text: Sat by the pool today in the bar/restaurant area. Courtney was our server and was AMAZING. She was very attentive to our table. The food was really really good. Highly recommend coming here for a relaxing sunny day.
reviews.author: Michael B.

reviews.text: What a great an environment. I've been there multiple times and every time it gets better. But the last time I went, Joel threw his twist on the presentation and made the experience one of a kind; then Avalon came on by and made it like a double tap dream team. Thank you for a wonderful experience and putting together a cohesive team adding to the beautiful experience. I will be coming back specifically to see these two people.
reviews.author: Taylor W.

reviews.text: The place had a great ambiance and had good music. This place is like a place you go to celebrate and then go out after. It gives those vibes. The place has a fun atmosphere. The food was good. I enjoyed the tacos. The drink was okay. I was sad they didn't have my frozen drink.
reviews.author: Courtney A.

reviews.text: Lauren was personable and on point with recommending the top dishes from appetizers to the main course. The price point was on point and the portions are hardy. We will be back.  We loved Lauren.
reviews.author: Brook M.

reviews.text:
Overrated. 

I had the $33 lobster ceviche and it was barely an appetizer plus they tossed Tajin on everything to enhance the flavor that wasn't there.
reviews.author: Megan P.

reviews.text: loved the vibe but not impressed with the menu. The sliders were dry and tasteless and who eats a giant loaf of bread as an appetizer?
reviews.author: Sue L.

reviews.text: A $28 Cobb salad for lunch diabolical. That being said, I ordered it hoping it would knock by socks off. Pretty sure the green goddess dressing was Trader Joe's green goddess. Also got the steak wrap. It was clunky and flavorless. Pretty much a bunch of Sysco slop. The decor looks like someone went on a 2010 Z-Gallery shopping spree. Service was whatever. The only redeeming thing were the cocktails. I would maybe go back and sit at the bar for a drink.
reviews.author: Natalie W.

reviews.text:
As a first time visitor the atmosphere inside was impressive. Our reservation was at 7:30pm. We were not seated until after 8pm. Once we were seated our drinks did not arrive until 8:45pm and then our second round didn't come out until almost 10pm. With our second round of drinks the bartender forgot one of the ladies drinks who then had to wait another thirty minutes for her drink and then when that lasts drink was served our check was brought to us without asking for it. 
The vibes inside were great but the service was very poor. While the servers were excellent and knowledgeable the wait time was something that needs to be addressed.
reviews.author: Reagan W.

reviews.text: Worst valet experience ever. Great food and service otherwise. But you might not get your vehicle back.
reviews.author: Lori H.

reviews.text: Des, Zita, Sara, and Parker were great! The food was excellent, service was great, ambiance is fire!!
reviews.author: Amanda A.

reviews.text:
Fabulous food, great service and beautiful vibes !!!
Came for a birthday and I am not disappointed !!
reviews.author: Nina Q.

reviews.text:
I know they are new and I loved the vibe and decorum and I want them to succeed however....  
I and six of my friends ordered and only two of us were satisfied with our meal.  Deep frying can be tricky since we ordered the fish and chips and fish tacos...they were very dark and crunchy.  But we didn't really complain. Just do better because bottom line a restaurant is all about the food! No?  We will go back.
reviews.author: Audrey M.

reviews.text: Great experience, everything was delicious, Ask for Amy if you want an amazing server!
reviews.author: Natalja T.

reviews.text: Good drinks, slow service, mediocre food, it's been 2 hours and 15 minutes and haven't seen deserts yet? And they aren't that busy either. I'll come back for a drink but one and done for any meals, even if staying at the hotel I would say walk across the street
reviews.author: Jeff M.

reviews.text:
I had a fantastic meal at Wolf and overall really enjoyed the experience. The restaurant has a great atmosphere, lively but still comfortable, and the food was excellent.

I started the evening with a couple of martinis, which were perfectly made--ice cold, balanced, and exactly what you want from a classic martini. They were a great way to start the meal.

For food, I ordered the Caesar wrap, the salmon with zucchini, and the grill balls. Everything was delicious. The Caesar wrap was fresh and flavorful, and the salmon was cooked beautifully--tender, well seasoned, and paired nicely with the zucchini. The goat cheese balls were amazing and easily one of the highlights of the meal. The flavor and texture were incredible, and they're something I would absolutely come back for.

One thing I really want to call out is Blake. He was the only person in the restaurant who was truly attentive throughout the day. While the rest of the staff seemed busy and somewhat distracted, stood out for being engaged, helpful, and making sure everything was taken care of. His level of service really elevated the experience and made the night much more enjoyable.

Overall, the food and drinks were excellent and the atmosphere was great. I'd definitely come back, and a big thank you to Blake for being so attentive and making the experience memorable.
reviews.author: Ryan C.
