reviews.text: Emmy was so fun and professiona! my friends and I really enjoyed him. I would absolutely ask for him again!
reviews.author: Amanda E.

reviews.text: We had the best experience at Wolf! Emy made us feel so welcome from the moment we arrived. His energy was amazing, and he truly made the whole experience even better. He was attentive, kind, and brought such a great spirit to our table. He would be an incredible server and anyone would be lucky to have him! Highly recommend asking for Emy if you visit.
reviews.author: Bernice T.

reviews.text: Emily was an absolutely amazing server. She took great care of our table of seven. She was friendly, knowledgeable and efficient which certainly added to our experience. The restaurant itself is well maintained and comfortable. It is filled with decor from top to bottom and wall to wall. If you are a minimalist, be prepared to catch your breath. All parties generally liked the food but we had a couple of colleagues that had to wait quite some time for their dinners. One was because she asked for no cheese on her burger and of course it came out with cheese. And the other was an order of bbq wings that just didn't make their way to the table. They did try to make it right by bringing a complimentary desert to the table so they get credit for that. The service really was magnificent.
reviews.author: Nancy M.

reviews.text: The ambience is absolutely amazing, had such a relaxing night. The service was amazing, we were greeted by everyone we passed and our waitress was so knowledgeable. The bathrooms were very cleanly and convenient. The food and cocktails tasted incredible, but I would say they were a little overpriced. They have a great selection of cocktails. Would recommend to try out!
reviews.author: Allie M.

reviews.text: Excellent food, great atmosphere. The prices are not too bad at all The drinks are fabulous and the service is very very invitive. Kenzie was taking care of me and she was awesome. I definitely recommend this place very good vibes sitting by the pool having a drink couldn't ask for more than that.
reviews.author: David J.

reviews.text: Love it here! The experience was incredible for my anniversary, Kelsey was one of the best servers we've ever had! The food was amazing loved the cheese board, and obviously classic Vanderpump vibes, wouldn't be a vibe without the chandlers!
reviews.author: Keith S.

reviews.text: I have to give the largest compliment to Des. The sweetest, most attentive, and knowledgeable person. Wolf is the perfect place for a dinner date. I personally recommend coming at sunset as it is a rooftop restaurant/bar. The food and drinks are purely a 10/10. There is nothing that can genuinely beat this service and atmosphere.
reviews.author: Makayla A.

reviews.text: Service was unbeatable! Des meets all the Vanderpump standards, attentive, accommodating and over the top! Couldn't have asked for a better experience we ordered shrimp cocktail, and caviar and chips!! Drinks were out of this world
reviews.author: Madelon Q.

reviews.text: First time in Arizona and Lexi was amazing! Amazing food excellent service and we can't wait to come back!
reviews.author: Shirena P.

reviews.text: Dined here for the first time to celebrate my birthday with my friends. 10/10 experience. Amazing food, drinks & service! We didn't know what to order since it was our first time visiting & our server Gabrielle had the best recommendations. We loved everything & really appreciated her showing us the ropes! We will definitely be back! Highly recommend!
reviews.author: Alexis H.

reviews.text: Had the best experience at wolf tonight! Our server Gabrielle/gabby was amazing. We only came in for apps and drinks but everything was great! She was extremely knowledgeable of the menu. So kind and friendly!!! Even a little funny. If you are dining here request her!!!
reviews.author: Danyelle H.

reviews.text:
I recently visited Wolf by Vanderpump in Scottsdale, and the space is exactly what you'd expect from Lisa Vanderpump. The entire restaurant is very Vanderpump-forward dark, glamorous, and dramatic. If you watch The Real Housewives of Beverly Hills, the aesthetic will feel very familiar. The decor, lighting, and overall vibe are beautiful and definitely one of the highlights.

Service was also very good. The staff was friendly and attentive, and overall I felt well taken care of.

The food, however, was underwhelming and took quite a while to come out. We tried a burger with fries, a Caesar salad with a parmesan crisp, and some appetizers. Nothing was bad, but nothing really stood out either. It tasted like food you could get at many other restaurants in Scottsdale, so it didn't feel particularly special.

The cocktails were the standout. The drinks were beautifully presented and very enjoyable definitely something I'd recommend ordering if you visit.

Overall I'd give it 3 out of 5 stars. I would still recommend checking it out if you're a fan of Lisa Vanderpump or want to experience the atmosphere, decor, and drinks. But if you're going mainly for outstanding food, you may want to explore other options nearby.
reviews.author: Joselynn B.

reviews.text:
Had an amazing dining experience for lunch, with breathing taking views and wonderful food. It was also so refreshing to have an outstanding and knowledgeable server named Nicole C. 

You guys hit the 3 things every reastaurant needs, ambiance,  service and food. Keep uo the good work.
reviews.author: Kevin W.

reviews.text: Atmosphere and food was amazing.  Coco' service was astounding and Emy was on top of it. Great experience! We'll be back!
reviews.author: Maggie E.

reviews.text:
The goat cheese balls are a must have the ambience and the Vanderpump experience is amazing!! Lisa does a wonderful job with her food drinks and staff....the chilean Seabass is amazing! I celebrated my birthday here and they did a wonderful job celebrating my special day...the caramel ice cream fudge brownie was amazing!! Vanderpump rosé is my go to!! 
Amy is the best server ever. She is friendly, outgoing, and definitely the best server ever! She deserves a raise!!  seriously come to the Wolf.
 It definitely is worthwhile experience.
reviews.author: Michelle W.

reviews.text: Reminds me of STK - great ambiance but mediocre food. Our server was very sweet and attentive. I don't understand the hype over the Signature Wolf bread - the presentation is lovely but flavor is pretty mid-tier. On the contrary, the goat cheese balls were everything!
reviews.author: Natalie D.

reviews.text: Our food was delicious. The staff was friendly. Our server Kelsey was nice and informative. ​
reviews.author: Shannon M.

reviews.text: We LOVE Coco!! She was so sweet and constantly checked up on us and even showed us the patio to take pictures with the beautiful view!! We will definitely be requesting her every time we come back! She is WONDERFUL!!
reviews.author: Annika W.

reviews.text: Gabby ruined my experience tn by making me and my friends wait 38 minutes for our main which was just pasta... I've been here 5 times before this and no issues. Keep in mind she checked on us 3 times without forgetting our main course. Never dine with her.
reviews.author: Sally H.

reviews.text: Coco was the best server!  Great food, beautiful decor and a gorgeous sunset view   The goat ball bites were delicious, and my husband loved the wolf burger
reviews.author: Cathy S.

reviews.text: The food was amazing, but honestly, the service was even better. Coco is the best.!  I highly recommend the cheese balls...
reviews.author: Rhonda P.

reviews.text:
Highly recommend making a reservation, especially if you want to go for dinner. My friend and I had a reservation for 5:30pm on a Sunday. We arrived early, so they told us we could go to the bar or go upstairs to the Camelback Veranda for a drink on the rooftop. We grabbed mocktails on the deck and enjoyed the mountainous views until we got a phone call that our table was ready. They let us bring our drinks with us. By then a lot more people were checking into the restaurant.

After having watched 11 seasons of Vanderpump Rules, I can say that the detailed, over-the-top decor was absolutely what you'd expect from a Lisa Vanderpump business. It had a darker, more mysterious vibe with lots of wolf sculptures and pictures. Some of the chairs looked like thrones. The entire restaurant had a great view of the mountains. They even opened some of the windows as the sun was setting - such a great photo op!

I really wanted to try the popular Pump-tini, but I was driving us. Maybe next time. We did get the famous goat cheese balls that Stassi was so obsessed with in the show. Honestly, it did not meet the hype for me - it was good, but I wouldn't go out of my way to get them. The truffle fries were good. We both got the Beurre Blanc salmon, which is coated with breadcrumbs that gave it a nice crunch. The dish is available gluten-free as well. It comes with seasonal vegetables and potatoes that were seasoned well. We looked at the dessert menu, but nothing piqued our interest.

Overall, we had a good experience here. The staff seemed well-trained and knew the menu very well. Our server was very friendly, personable, and attentive. I would come back and try some of the cocktails and other dishes.
reviews.author: Christine T.

reviews.text:
Wolf by Vanderpump in Scottsdale absolutely exceeded our expectations! From the moment we walked in, the experience was incredible.

Before being seated, we spent some time at the bar where Francesco crafted some of the best cocktails we've ever had. He's truly a drink master--creative, perfectly balanced drinks and a fun personality that made the time fly by.

Once seated, our server Destiny took the experience to another level. She was incredibly knowledgeable about the menu, had an amazing personality, and made the entire evening feel special. Her recommendations and attention to detail really elevated the night.

The food was outstanding. My wife ordered the sea bass, which was cooked perfectly and absolutely delicious. I had the bone-in prime rib, and it was equally impressive--perfectly cooked, flavorful, and one of the best I've had.

The atmosphere is incredible. The rooftop views of the city are stunning and create such a great vibe for the entire evening.

Between the exceptional service, amazing drinks, incredible food, and beautiful setting, everything about Wolf by Vanderpump was a 5-star experience. We'll definitely be back.
reviews.author: Scott U.

reviews.text:
Another beautiful restaurant concept by the Lisa Vanderpump. This is her first restaurant in Arizona and the vibes totally match her normal aesthetic. It's a bit hard to find within the Caesars Republic, you have to go past the desk & to the elevators and down a hallway. Once there. i was in love with the natural sunlight & gorgeous views. 

The menu features various small plates like the famous goat cheese balls & larger plates. I opted for sharing a few of apps paired with some Vanderpump rosé. I didn't like the bread as much as I thought I would, the black lava butter was far too salty & it tasted a bit over cooked. The tuna tostadas were my favorite, very tasty. I'll have to come back to try some of the main entrees next time. 

Overall it was a great visit. The service was fantastic, food & drinks were tasty and vibes were lovely. I'll definitely be back again soon.
reviews.author: Erika N.

reviews.text: Came  here for a business dinner, and I'll say that the appetizers are pretty decent. The prices on the apps are decent as are the prices of the food but quite honestly the food was nothing to really stand out. The one thing I will say though is the drinks are extremely expensive and the service was very subpar numerous times I had to ask for more water and after ordering a drink, it took forever for me to get it by the time. I actually got it. I was already done with dinner.
reviews.author: L H.

reviews.text: Food is mediocre. Service is mediocre. I stayed at this hotel for three nights so unfortunately was forced to eat here multiple times. I had the steak salad, burger, ceasar salad and steak wrap. It's all not very good but the best thing was the wrap and it's only on the lunch menu.
reviews.author: Omeed N.

reviews.text: We came in for drinks and some appetizers. I got the everything bagel martini. The taste was great but they gave me a dried up piece of rosemary in my drink. I only realized when my friends drink came out and she had a lush, supple garnish. Only bothered me due to the price of the drink. We got the goat cheese balls and the bread. Both were awful and dry. The bread was cold and the butter was difficult to spread as it felt like it had just came out of the freezer. The place was aesthetically please, however. Don't think I'll be back but I'm glad I at least checked it out.
reviews.author: Mia A.

reviews.text: I had one of the best dining experiences in Scottsdale here! We had a reservation for a birthday and this was the first restaurant that acknowledged a birthday when I put it on the reservation... SHOCKING. Three different workers acknowledged, they even wrote a card for my friend so so cute and a birthday dessert. Huge thank you to Emily our server, 10/10 service and I loved that she also watched Vanderpump. The food was delicious and our waters never went empty. We added the chimichurri to our Ribeye, best decision. The ambiance and sunset were beautiful, so many small details I adored. Next time I'll be sure to request sitting by the open window during sunset, love this place.
reviews.author: Hiilei W.

reviews.text:
Go for a cocktail and then leave and eat elsewhere!

Went there last night.....

Shrimp cocktail.  The shrimp are delicious....& huge!  But then you get a tiny serving of bottled cocktail sauce.

The goat cheese balls are good.... But not enough sauce for the 4 on the plate so it's just a huge thing of goat cheese in your mouth.

The Lobster Ceviche tacos had a funny taste to them.... So I didn't eat the whole thing.

And the sauce for the crab "fritters" had no taste.

If you want the ambiance this is the place.  If you want GOOD food.... Go somewhere else.
reviews.author: Amy G.

reviews.text: Since the restaurant opened, I've been a guest on two separate occasions. During my first occasion, our server made fun of individuals  with special needs and when we brought attention of her behavior to the manager, they did nothing. The second occasion was for a bachelorette party that I was in attendance at tonight. Not only did we not get seated until 10pm, when our reservation was at 9 PM, but we didn't get our food until 11 PM. It was extremely frustrating for the entire bridal party. The only redeeming quality was that our server this evening, Lauren, was kind and attentive. Overall I am extremely disappointed in both experiences. I work in the service industry myself as a server and was impressed by her attentiveness, but other than that, super disappointed. Food was mid, drinks were good.
reviews.author: Audrey P.

reviews.text:
We had such an incredible experience at Wolf! The restaurant itself is absolutely gorgeous -- the ambiance is stunning with a beautiful view on the 7th floor, upscale, and thoughtfully designed. It's the kind of place that feels special the moment you walk in.

The food? Amazing. Every dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavor. You can truly tell the kitchen takes pride in what they serve.

And Sabrina made our night even better. She was attentive, warm, knowledgeable, and made us feel completely taken care of without ever being overbearing. Her service was seamless and elevated the entire experience. She is a sweetheart!! 

Highly recommend asking for Sabrina when you go -- and definitely don't skip on trying multiple dishes because everything was delicious!

We'll absolutely be back.
reviews.author: Lea A.

reviews.text:
We enjoyed dinner at Wolf 
and Lauren was an outstanding server! whatever she recommended we had and everything was delicious!
reviews.author: Karen B.

reviews.text: Cool place but the food was mediocre. The goat cheese balls were just ok and felt like something you can get for a lot less. The tuna was very fishy smelling and not fresh. Our waiter was very nice and funny making it much better. I guess we had high hopes but definitely not a place I will go often.
reviews.author: Dani L.

reviews.text: Alicia was so amazing!! She made our experience so memorable! Her recommendations were on point. The food was great and this was an incredible evening! Alicia is an asset worth investing in! Thank you!
reviews.author: Jennifer H.

reviews.text:
3 stars is generous. I would say more like 2.5. The 2.5 goes towards the ambiance. It's a beautiful restaurant. That's where the fun ended for us. 
Service was terrible. It was so slow that our food came before our drinks. The goat cheese balls tasted like cream cheese. No sign of goat cheese. We ordered the beet salad with dressing on the side. (Beautiful presentation but missed the mark on taste). It came drenched in dressing. We told the server but she just shrugged it off. My friends ordered the sliders, the shrimp tacos and some truffle fries. I ordered the chicken. They said the sliders and tacos were fine. Their fries were cold and they could not taste truffle. My chicken was so overly salted that it was inedible. I let the server know and she said she would let the chef know. No one ever came out to apologize or offer to make it right. I was charged for something I could not eat.  (I would have taken one properly seasoned to go). Clearly the waitstaff is not well trained. 
Drinks were good once we got them. I would sit at the bar and have drinks but I would not dine there. They have had enough time to work out the kinks so I'm assuming this is the best they can do. Too bad.
reviews.author: Melissa S.

reviews.text:
If you're looking for a chill, Lisa Vanderpump aesthetic -level evening in Scottsdale - this is it.

We planned the ultimate GNO at Wolf by Vanderpump inside Caesars Republic Scottsdale, and from the moment we walked in, it was pure magic. Having lived in Scottsdale before moving back to the Midwest, we wanted something that felt elevated, glamorous, and worthy of a reunion night with my besties. We heard great things about Wolf and they delivered - and then some.

The space is stunning: cozy yet upscale, dripping in that signature "Vanderpump aesthetic" - sultry lighting, lux decor, and the kind of ambiance that makes you want to order that martini with caviar immediately. And just when we thought it couldn't get better? A flawless sunset over Camelback Mountain. Cue the main character energy.

To start, I ordered the Pump & Bump Caviar Martini - simple yet dramatic, decadent, and absolutely on brand. Naturally, we had to get the famous Goat Cheese Balls (because IYKYK).

For our mains, we embraced the ultimate "girl dinner" strategy: split the Campari Tomatoes salad, split the 14 oz Prime Ribeye Tagliata (with leftovers to go), and of course, an order of Truffle Fries

Every bite was indulgent without feeling heavy- perfect for lingering, enjoying the vibes, and living our best "Scottsdale (work trip & local living) lives.

To close the night, we ordered the Wolf Churros, which are generously portioned (easily enough for 4). The rum caramel and creme anglaise balanced everything beautifully - sweet, warm, and the ideal ending. But as the final cohesion, we added on a "tipsy scoop" of ice cream - highly recommended!

Service elevated the entire experience. Our server Lexi was attentive, polished, and effortlessly cool all evening. Manager Parker was equally impressive - personable, welcoming, and operating with five-star GM energy. He even gave us a tour of the event spaces, as my bestie has been scoping some locations for her upcoming life events.

All in all, if you're visiting Scottsdale - or simply want a dining experience that feels glamorous yet relaxed - Wolf by Vanderpump at Caesars Republic is your spot. It's not just dinner. It's an experience.

Five stars. No notes.
reviews.author: Amy N.

reviews.text:
Great place to meet the girlfriends and have some cocktails and appetizers. Two of us intended on getting lunch but filled up on the bread and goat cheese balls (also expensive). We paid $90 for 2 cocktails, bread and goat cheese balls 

But the ambiance is great, big open windows to see the mountains and a lot of light we had a great server who was super bubbly and had lots of good recs

reviews.text: Lexi was amazingggg!! Service was quick and pleasant. My sister in law was celebrating her birthday, Lexi made sure everything was smooth! Love it and will be back!

reviews.text: Highly recommend. Had lunch here and had the best service from Lexi. She was very attentive and will definitely be coming back.

reviews.text: We made reservations over a month ago and we were so excited to dine at Wolf. We had reservations for 7pm on a Saturday. The restaurant is stunning. Every inch. We were sat right away and immediately asked what type of water we'd like and were served. The service the entire evening was great. Gabby took really good care of us and gave us her honest thoughts about food/drink choices, which I appreciated. To drink I had the Wolf in Sheep's Clothing. It's SPICY but it also has cotton candy with 24k gold flakes and I couldn't pass up ordering it. It was beautiful and fun but man it'll hit ya right in the chest. My friend's husband ordered the Smokey Old Fashioned. The waitress who brought it from the bar made a big show out of the presentation, which was fun and added to our experience. We ordered a few different appetizers: Goat Cheese Balls, Crabcake Hushpuppies, Wolf Bread and the Wagu Sliders. I'd order all of them again but let me tell you I think that might be the best bread I've ever put in my mouth and I've eaten a lot of bread!! The Goat Cheese Balls were also phenomenal and at Gabbys recommendation eat with a bit of the slaw that comes on the plate. Totally different flavor experience. They are rich but the vinegar in the slaw takes it all next level. For my entree I had the burger, which you may think why would I order a burger at a place like this? Because like nothing here this isn't your average burger. The wagu patties melt in your mouth, pickles 2 ways and tabasco crunchy onions made this burger 10/10. The fries are really flavorful, as well. Also at the table was ordered Sea Bass, bolognese, salmon, shrimp tacos and the fried fish. Everyone loved their food BUT the tacos. Definitely missed the mark for my friend. She commented the tortillas were raw but somehow hard, the shrimp was cold and it lacked flavor. For dessert we had the churro basket, which was perfect for a crowd. I think there were 8 good sized churros served with caramel, chocolate sauce and bananas. They were good. I really was so excited about dining here. I'm a Vanderpump fan and Lisa did not disappoint. The restaurant also has their own small pool area w/ bar that is sure to be packed soon. The 8th floor of the hotel has Camelback Veranda, which is also a bar area with gorgeous views of Camelback Mountain. We visited before our dinner to catch the sunset and after to see the city lights. There was a live band playing, lots of comfortable seating and great vibes.
reviews.author: Cherry M.

reviews.text: Absolutely amazing! Amy is the best server! She was so entertaining! Great service!! We celebrated my mom's birthday and she made it so special! She was so funny and really made this experience special. Food was great and drinks were amazing!!!! I was really excited to try Wolf by Vanderpump at Caesars Republic Scottsdale, especially given the hype around anything associated with Lisa Vanderpump. Unfortunately, this was a huge disappointment.

The service was slow and disorganized from the start. The bartender was nice enough, but barely came around to check on us, so we often found ourselves waiting longer than we should have for drinks. It wasn't terrible, just inattentive.

We were never taken to our table because she seemed far more interested in flirting with her coworkers than doing her job. It was unprofessional and frustrating, especially since we had booked ahead.

As for the food -- the goat cheese balls are completely overrated. They're hyped up as a must-have, but they were underwhelming and not worth the price.

reviews.text:
I visited Wolf this past Saturday, Valentine's Day, for a late lunch at 2:45 PM. The only other reservation I saw was for 10 PM, which surprised me since the restaurant was not very busy when we arrived. We made it just on time for our reservation and were told our table was "on hold for 15 minutes," which ended up meaning a brief wait. We were seated around 3 PM.

We started with the signature Wolf bread, which was slightly warm, though I would have preferred it hotter. I loved the hot honey butter, although it was more sweet than spicy for me. The whipped lava salt butter was good, with a light, fluffy texture and black salt sprinkled on top. Despite the dark, crusty-looking exterior, the bread was soft inside. I would definitely order this again.

Next, we tried the goat cheese balls. I enjoy lemony flavors, and these were very lemon-forward, perhaps a bit too much for me after a few bites. Some extra sauce would have been helpful to balance the flavor. The slaw was fresh, though it lacked the sweetness I expected from pear. I probably would not order this again.

For my main course, I had the beurre blanc salmon. The salmon was cooked beautifully, tender and flaky, but I wished the toasted breadcrumbs added more crunch to complement the soft texture. The sauce was light and subtly lemony, and I considered adding some salt to boost the flavor. Overall, it felt like the dish aimed to showcase the natural taste of the fish and vegetables rather than offer bold flavors. While I enjoy salty, robust dishes, I appreciate the subtlety in fish because it allows the flavor to shine, even if it is not a flavor explosion.

My husband ordered the Wolf burger and absolutely loved it.

Overall, service was great, despite being seated slightly later than our reservation. I enjoyed the meal, though I felt some dishes could have used more flavor or texture but Wolf is a pretty restaurant and offers a nice atmosphere. That said, the subtle, well-executed preparations may be just right for others.

reviews.text: Holy crap I was so excited to try this place but let me tell you firsthand do NOT come with high expectations. We came February 15th at 5:30(to see if we could get sat early) for a 7pm reservation that had been made over a month before. We didn't get sat until 7:46 after watching multiple groups of 2,4 and 8 people being sat before us. We did get complementary champagne but they didn't ID anyone for it. At 6:50 we double checked we were checked in for our reservation. At 7:15 we asked what the status of being seated was, we were told another 5 minutes. Around 7:30 we reached back out asking when our table would be ready because we hadn't been updated at all and we were told about 5 minutes only to be sat more than 15 minutes later. Once sat we found dirty utensils under the table. Interested in trying a pumptini? They were out:/ Goat cheese balls were EXTREMELY underwhelming. On top of all this we were hit with a ventue/admin fee of 3.5%. After looking into this more it seems to cover staffing, set up, and clean up for events. reviews.text:
We made reservations 30 days in advance, so imagine our surprise when we still had to wait 20 minutes to be seated. Not exactly the grand entrance we were expecting.

When the three of us were finally taken to our table, it was pretty obvious it was set for two. Two of us had regular chairs... and I was perched on what can only be described as a decorative foot stool. Humbling, to say the least.

Now for drinks. It's a Vanderpump restaurant -- of course we're ordering Pumptinis. Except... strike three. No Pumptinis available. The audacity. The heartbreak. The scandal.

On to appetizers. "May we have some bread?"
Nope. No bread.
A restaurant being out of bread feels chaotic.

Main course time:
The Wagyu slider was cooked as ordered and had good flavor -- solid. However, the bacon was... stretchy? I don't know how else to describe it, but bacon should not require effort.

We ordered truffle fries and wings and asked for ranch.
"Yeah... we're out of ranch."
At this point we were starting to feel personally victimized.

Now for the redemption arc:
The mac & cheese was excellent. The truffle fries and wings had great flavor. The drinks we were able to order were very good. And if you're seated in the right spot, the view is absolutely spectacular.

So here we are. Slightly disappointed but not defeated.

I'll give you another try. Don't disappoint me, Lisa and Pandora.

reviews.text: This was an amazing experience! Recommend 10/10. My husband & I had just visited Wolf by Vanderpump at Caesar's Republic South Lake Tahoe & were blown away from our amazing bartender to the Iberical Pork chops & the prime rib sliders. We had high expectations & a little nervous due to reviewer we've read & heard from friends who came when it first opened. We came for Valentine's Day & had another amazing experience. The menu was similar with a little differences but everything we ate was top notch, the service & friendliness of the staff was the same from Tahoe to Arizona. Our waitress Sara was so attentive she went above and beyond she even got the name of our bartender from Tahoe to write a sparkling review. reviews.text:
We picked Wolf for a girls' night and  were really excited to try it.  The space is absolutely beautiful and the energy is great, which is why this review is honestly difficult to write.

I want to preface this by saying I am not blaming our server. She was kind and apologetic throughout the night. I also understand the restaurant is fairly new, and there can absolutely be growing pains  in the beginning like small mistakes or delays. That said, the number of issues we experienced felt like more than just a small learning curve.

The  moment we sat down, things just kept going wrong in a way that almost felt satirical. We were the only table with a non-working lamp, and it took 3 attempts over a 30 minute period before one finally worked. A small detail, but it set the tone.

When ordering drinks, 2 of the 3 frozen cocktail options were unavailable. After selecting another, we were told that one was also out.

The most disappointing part of the night was the food. The filet was ordered medium-well but arrived medium-rare, and after sending it back, there was about a 45 minute delay before it returned. At this point the rest of our table had finished their meals. The mac and cheese was also heavily over salted. Not just flavorful, but to the point where we were literally crunching into salt granules in the middle of the dish, making it inedible.

Reading this back, it probably sounds nitpicky because there are so many small details listed. But honestly, thats the point. It was the accumulation of issue after issue throughout the night. Any one of them on its own would have been easy to overlook. Together, they made the night feel misaligned with the restaurants reputation.

By the end of the night, the repeated issues made us feel more like we were being managed rather than hosted. It honestly felt like our table wasn't a priority compared to others around us.

I  wanted to come back. The restaurant is stunning, and we had even talked about coming again to sit on the balcony next time. After this experience, im not sure I will, which makes me sad, because I really wanted to love it!

Given how overwhelmingly positive the reviews are, I'm still confused about how everything we personally ordered ended up being such a miss. Again I understand new restaurants take time to find their rhythm, but this felt like more than just a few small hiccups.

We walked in excited and left feeling disappointed.

reviews.text: Came here for a friend's birthday and it's so unfortunate to give this place such a bad review because it has so much potential to be a really cool spot in Scottsdale given name and location. Waited over an hour for our reservation that was at 7:45pm... on a Wednesday..... due to a corporate event upstairs that was "taking up all the tables downstairs". With much appreciation, the manager granted us a round of shots, drinks and apps on the house while we waited outside (45 minutes after we got there). They weren't bad and it was very generous. The servers were fine, the guy who filled our water was very apologetic and understanding. The table we sat at was definitely better seated for a group who was just planning to get drinks as the seats did not have a backing and had more of a lounge vibe. Waited a while for our entrees and the risotto was BLAH. Birthday brownie was literally disgusting we had to spit it out. So alls to say, if you just wanna have a drink in an aesthetic restaurant this is the place! Don't bother with the food, maybe the bread & butter and tuna tostados... but I miss Seven.

reviews.text:
One of our friends sent this restaurant in the group chat and two of us are vanderpump fans. Since my time in AZ is limited, I always pick new and different restaurants for us to go to. We had very high expectations for this place and we left more than satisfied. We tried a bunch apps (I forgot to take a picture of the wolf bread, which was everyone's favorite). The drinks were all different and fun, and the main courses were the icing on top. We were shocked at how well the menu was made. Someone in the group ordered the fish and chips and my BIL's dad told us how back in Buffalo, NY there was a small dive bar that had the best fish and chips he's ever had. They now live in CA and haven't been able to find a place that was similar. He said Wolf had that nostalgic flavor he had been missing for years. We all left stuffed and in awe that the restaurant isn't just a pretty place with a well known name, it lives up to the hype. 

Every single person working at this restaurant was amazing. They know how to treat their customers and make everyone feel special. Our waitress Amy was such a joy and made us all laugh with her quirkiness. She was always attentive and the wait staff was constantly on top of it. It was such an enjoyable dinner with family and friends. Thank you Amy and everyone for making it a special night.

I had to add salt. The drinks were very good and the service was outstanding! But the food left me slightly disappointed.
reviews.author: Sylvia C.

reviews.text: I really wanted to like this place, but I've been twice now and the food and drinks just aren't great. The steak, the salmon, the sea bass just genuinely had no flavor. Goat cheese balls and the bread were good. Desert was okay but again really struggled to taste it. Drinks were way way too sweet. However with all that said , the ambiance is gorgeous and totally worth a visit. Staff was so sweet and friendly. Recommend skipping the food and just do a quick drink at the bar during sunset.
reviews.author: Emily R.

reviews.text: The restaurant is beautiful. Signature wolf bread was amazing! Filet, lobster tacos, crab hush puppies also fabulous. Drinks were on point.... Loved the Peter Rabbit! We will be back.
reviews.author: Tara T.

reviews.text: Staff were extremely friendly and professional, the ambiance was such a vibe & even caught a view of the sunset. Amazing food and drinks to top our visit. Will definitely be back.
reviews.author: Penny B.

reviews.text: Wasn't worth the hype. The service was beyond slow. We made reservations, played outside on a small table & if we wanted inside it was a 45min wait. The food was mediocre, cold by the time it got to us. Overly priced for basic. The drinks were "neat" but overly priced. The table shouldn't have been so wobbly for being a new space. We ordered the goat cheese balls, bland. The lobster tacos were good. The sea bass was cold and okay, the pork tomahawk was good. The risotto was okay... there were 8 of us. It took 2 1/2 hours to have dinner and drinks on a Tuesday. No need to ever return.
reviews.author: Jess W.

reviews.text: Service was good, the food was not. Everything was just ok, mostly meh, we ordered goat cheese balls, bread, tostadas, lobster taco appy, risotto, fillets, sea bass, prawn tacos and three desserts, the cobbler was inedible, just horrible. The rest of the food was just ok, definitely not worth the price. The drinks were good, except the espresso martini, its premade on tap and gross, the Peter rabbit was awesome. Will I go back, no, but happy to say I tried it.
reviews.author: Brandy B.

reviews.text:
Kinda dark and gloomy. Camelback Mountain is ignored. But decent food.

We came for happy hour; we live across the street. great bar service. Drinks and apps. 

Hush puppies A+. Signature bread B. Mac n cheese B-.

I'm no hipster but I don't understand why they turned Seven into this. 

How many celebrities does this hotel need? I'd love to be on the elevator with Giada when the Wolf lady  gets on. 

Won't be back soon.
reviews.author: Doug B.

reviews.text: Food was great! Ambiance was amazing! Workers were very attentive and kind. I would definitely recommend this spot.
reviews.author: Aubrie ..

reviews.text:
I was so excited I could scream to finally try Wolf by Vanderpump! From the second you step off the elevator into that stunning B&W photo-op with Lisa, you know you're in for a treat. 
OMGGGGG! Lisa really did the damn thing with the decor. Between the "glass snow" chandeliers and the faux fur chairs, I felt like royalty. The attention to detail--down to the Wolf-engraved pillows--is top-notch.

 Hits: The drinks are incredibly well-balanced (A+ on the mocktails too!). The lobster ceviche tacos were so fresh and crunchy we ordered three more. And the CHURROS... absolute deep-fried perfection.

 Misses: The goat cheese balls are tasty but tart, so ask for extra marmalade! Unfortunately, the "Wolf Bread" was only lukewarm, and the lobster balls were a huge letdown--cold and fishy.

The service was stellar--shout out to Parker (manager) and Laura (server) for being so gracious! 

Wolf has only been open a couple of months, so I'm giving them some "new kid on the block" grace. Scottsdale is a foodie mecca, so I hope the kitchen tightens up those temps soon. I'll be back to give it another shot!
reviews.author: Ann Y.

reviews.text:
Made a reservation for me and my daughter at 8:45, had to wait another 15 minutes just to be seated which defeats the purpose of a reservation. We were offered to sit at the bar?
Not sure why but we decided to wait for a table. The service was extremely slow and the food was ok, nothing out of the ordinary. Ordered the salmon and the vegetables under it were extremely raw. There is also a venue admin fee that is no where to be seen in the menu, if you're going to charge extra fees please allow the customer to make a choice. Don't think i'll be back and will definitely not recommend. Too many options around the area that are way better.
reviews.author: Sara G.

reviews.text: The service and cleanliness of the bar can most definitely improve. Considering the amount of money we were spending there someone should have checked on us more than twice even at the bar. The ambiance and aesthetic of the place was superb. The food was okay. I really enjoyed the dirty martini and Mac and cheese.
reviews.author: Hope H.

reviews.text: This place is a vibe! Everyone who worked there was so kind and attentive! Def order the bread & goat cheese balls!  Go check this place out you won't be disappointed:)
reviews.author: Lauren K.

reviews.text: A Friday night during busy season.  The food was decent, but there are so many choices in Scottsdale that have food just as good.   We live close by and know about all the places to go. The thing that really turned us off was the noise level.  It was deafening. There were four of us and we had to scream to have any semblance of a conversation.  So bad I could not wait to leave.  I could have rated it one star, but I'm in a generous mood.  Maybe we will return in July when no one is in town.
reviews.author: Andrew P.

reviews.text: The food was just okay. The salmon was drowned in so much butter that it completely overpowered the flavor. Unfortunately, they were out of several items from their own menu, which was disappointing. The manager did make an effort to compensate for this, which I appreciated. Our server was very friendly, though not very knowledgeable about the menu. Seating was uncomfortable, and the large, gaudy furniture made the space feel cramped; staff and patrons were frequently bumping into our chairs. Overall, it was an okay experience, I probably wouldn't return.
reviews.author: Harmoni P.

reviews.text: A great time was had at Wolf last night. The theme is Lisa Vanderpumo and you're surrounded by her and her fans. The staff are also huge fans and that added a nice touch as everyone seems to be happy to be there. The service was great and although the menu isn't extensive, it was excellent! Caviar and the famous goat cheese balls  to whet the appetite and the drinks were flowing. It's Scottsdale so drink up! It's a fun, vibrant restaurant with a theme the ladies love!
reviews.author: Jaleebi S.

reviews.text:
Wolf is a great upgrade from the previous restaurant at this location. 

My only issue is the undisclosed 3.5% venue fee. 
Not a fan of surprises when I get my bill. 
I even rechecked the menu as I left and this was not listed anywhere (as required per AZ law). 

Otherwise it was fantastic. The bartender was friendly and gave me an extra pour since they only serve 6oz wine vs many 9oz options in the Valley. 

Our dinner was delicious as we all had a different dish and all walked away satisfied with the meal. 

The cost of dinner was very reasonable - entrees were priced right, drinks a little high, however that's expected since that's where restaurants make their $$$. 

Again, only issue was the surprise 3.5% venue fee. 
Our waitress knew it was coming when we asked and quickly stated it was the hotel charging us. 

Either way...that should be stated upfront..similar to establishments that charge for using a credit card. 

Like their valet, which recommends a $10 tip and has a small convenience charge if you use a credit card via the link provided for the $12 service.
reviews.author: Dave H.

reviews.text: The decor and atmosphere is amazing.  The restaurant designer is brilliant.   I would love to just sit there with a drink feeling fabulous in this environment. Now on the other hand I have something different to say about the food and service.  Though our server was pleasant, he seemed very junior and new to the service industry.   He was not very engaging and his comments seemed very rehearsed (or not rehearsed enough). As for the food, it left us underwhelmed. I've tried the goat cheese balls in her other restaurants and was less than satisfied.  I thought I would try them again thinking I may have missed why they were so famous. They are very much like jalapeño popper without the jalapeño or the flavor. They were just OK. The steak wrap is less than what I would have made at home. It was just ok and nothing special you would want to come back to order.  With such a beautiful restaurant, I would think there would be more special items on the menu.  Go for the atmosphere but not the food.
reviews.author: Footie D.

reviews.text: I booked Wolf for my husband's birthday lunch and I don't think we will be returning. The decor is gaudy/kitschy in the light of day- all cheap fake flowers and foliage. The service leaves much to be desired. When we checked in for the reservation the hostess acknowledged the birthday celebration but our server Blake never mentioned it once. The wait for the food after ordering was much too long, especially considering the restaurant was maybe 35% full. The food itself was ok- the goat cheese balls and the fish and chips were excellent. . . the tuna tostada was under seasoned and really difficult to eat. After we finished eating and our plates were cleared, we sat for at least 15 minutes waiting for Blake. . . I thought maybe he would bring a small dessert for the birthday but after waiting for so long we signaled to him for the check and that was that. All in all, I expect much more for a $96 lunch. I predict based on this experience that the restaurant will not be in business long once the Vanderpump shine wears off.
reviews.author: Isabella Y.

reviews.text: Wasn't sure how good the food and service was going to be since it's so popular. But food and service was a 10/10 the food was so flavorful and fresh! The service was wonderful. The bread with the hot honey butter is phenomenal. The waygu cheeseburger was so juicy. My family is hard to please and it's rare when we all agree on a restaurant but we all loved it. 10/10
reviews.author: grayce c.

reviews.text:
Wolf by Vanderpump in Scottsdale is equal parts restaurant and experience. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere sets the tone -- dark, moody, and sexy with luxe textures, dramatic lighting, and that signature Vanderpump flair. It feels upscale without being stuffy, making it perfect for a date night, girls' night, or celebratory dinner.

The cocktails are the real star here. Creative, bold, and beautifully presented, they're clearly designed to be as fun as they are delicious. This is the kind of place where ordering a drink is part of the entertainment.

Food-wise, the menu offers elevated comfort dishes and shareables that are great for the table. Some plates truly shine, while others are more solid than standout -- but overall, the food complements the vibe rather than competes with it. This is a place you come to enjoy the full experience, not rush through a meal.

Service was friendly and attentive, though the energy of the room can get lively and loud during peak hours. If you're looking for a quiet, intimate dinner, this may not be your spot -- but if you want a fun, high-energy night out with great drinks and a stylish crowd, Wolf delivers.

Final take: Wolf by Vanderpump Scottsdale is a vibe. Go for the cocktails, the ambiance, and the experience -- and consider the food a bonus. It's glamorous, fun, and very on-brand for Scottsdale nightlife.
reviews.author: Paige O.

reviews.text: Visited on a Saturday night. The restaurant is beautiful but the music was very loud, the restaurant had a weird smell (maybe all the fur), and the service was not great. The servers seemed inexperienced. We waited awhile for drinks and the Berry Sexy Mocktail was not good.. there were only 2 NA options which was disappointing. The goat cheese balls came out after our entrees. My friend let them know she had a dairy allergy and she was given salmon with cheese all over the potatoes. However, the salmon, churros, and goat cheese balls were delicious! There was also an admin fee added to the bill. Not sure if I would visit again.
reviews.author: Ty

reviews.text:
Wolf by Vanderpump Restaurant is an experience, not just a meal. From the moment you walk in, the atmosphere is next-level dark, moody, elegant, and buzzing with energy without ever feeling overwhelming. It's the kind of place where every detail feels intentional.

The food? Truly amazing. Every dish was beautifully presented and packed with flavor, the kind that makes you pause mid-bite and just appreciate what you're eating. You can tell there's real care behind the menu, and nothing felt ordinary or forgettable.

Between the phenomenal atmosphere and the outstanding food, Wolf completely lived up to the hype and then some. Perfect for a special night out or when you just want to feel like you're somewhere iconic. Can't wait to come back.
reviews.author: Briana O.

reviews.text: Adore this spot. Especially the energy and view 10/10. I might be biased because i adore the bartender Taylor and Liz! But Lisa has an eye for design i swear! The veranda needsssss frozen drinks in the summer i would come here just for a tan and a fancy frose. Band was killer keep them forever. I want them at my wedding.
reviews.author: Rachel W.

reviews.text: What a night! I came for a girls night with a perfect patio, sunset, yummy food and great drinks. To top the night off our server, Amy, was amazing. She was attentive and hilarious. Definitely, ask for her section and the Dirty Dog Martini.
reviews.author: Tiffany H.

reviews.text: Vanderpump restaurants are always about the vibes and aesthetic and less about the food. Cocktails are always delicious and done well, including the Snowbird. The bread was a table favorite of the night, the butters were great. I'm not a goat cheese fan, but I was told they were good but wished the sauce was better setup for dipping and not spread on the plate. The fish and chips were good and for the amount of food is was appropriately priced. The Bolognese had a good amount of meat, I was told the dish as a whole was under seasoned. Our waitress was friendly, but we did have an issue with the food runner for our entrees. All three entree, fish and chips and two bolognese were brought out at the same time but taken to the table next to us and sat down on their table (they ordered after us). They also ordered pasta but mentioned no fish and chips so the runner picked that up and then realized it was for our table. However, because the pastas that should have come to us were left at the other table, I sat for 10 minutes waiting for the two pastas to come out to our table so we could eat at the same time. Also, the table behind us who had the pastas that were for our table, had to wait for their entrees to catch up for the rest of their table which made it obvious a mistake was made. Our waitress did make a comment when the pastas came out about "sorry for the error on the plates coming out". So by the time the fish and chips were ate, they were cold.
reviews.author: Tiffany D.

reviews.text: Wow, just wow! Went here for the first time for my birthday dinner. The wagu burger was the best burger I've ever had! The Pumptini and goat cheese balls before our entrees were perfect! Service was great with so many friendly servers and staff. Can't wait to go again.
reviews.author: Deanna M.

reviews.text: My friend and I got drinks and apps here last night and it was amazing!! One of the best dirty martinis I've ever had and the pumptini was also amazing. Barrett was our server and he makes you feel right at home. He was so kind and funny and very knowledgeable with the menu!!
reviews.author: Lauren F.

reviews.text: I really wanted to like this place because we live right across the street. The first attempt to eat here ended up with them telling us to get back into line after we viewed the tables at 4:15. Table for four at 4:30 specifically booked to view the sunset. They couldn't figure out the sun. Opened and closed the blinds and windows and we completely missed the sunset. Restaurant was dirty. Food etc all over the floor. Tried to ignore it but DURING  our main meal  a server started sweeping the floor into a dustbin right beside us. Ridiculous. 5 star?  Food was ok. Wings good but undercooked. Beet salad good but kitchen wouldn't split. Pork chop had raw parts sent back. Fish and chips fine. White wine warm. Sent back. Said fridge wasn't  working. So many staff but nothing to do. They walked around the room and bumped the bank of my chair more times than I could count. We decided to gut purposes and said we would take our remaining drink dnd go to 8th floor.  A suit told us ok. We get up there and it was closed to a private event. It is pretty but gimmicky. Locals won't go back. Save your money and go to Ocean  44 across the street.
reviews.author: Deborah A.

reviews.text:
I went to Wolf for a drink and appetizer and sat at the bar- great experience!
The vanderpump rosé and wolf bread were delicious! 
Amazing service, the bartender was very welcoming, and the girl that brought me food and water was sweet and made sure I had everything I'd need!
I will definitely be back again!
reviews.author: Olivia M.

reviews.text:
I rarely write reviews, but I felt compelled to share our experience because what was meant to be a very special evening ended in disappointment, especially for a restaurant that prides itself on being "an experience."
My daughters and I are longtime fans of Vanderpump Rules, so when we heard that Wolf was opening in Scottsdale, it was a no-brainer for my daughter to book it to celebrate my birthday on January 10th. She made the reservation a month in advance, and the only dining times available were 6:00 p.m. or after 8:00 p.m., a clear sign this was a highly anticipated and in-demand spot. We chose the 6:00 p.m. reservation.
First, the positives: the restaurant itself is absolutely stunning. The views of Camelback Mountain at sunset were breathtaking, and the decor is gorgeous. Every detail felt intentional and upscale. The hostess seated us and enthusiastically told us we were in for a great experience, which only heightened our expectations.
Unfortunately, that excitement quickly faded. When our server came to take our drink orders, she immediately let us know that several menu items were already unavailable. They were out of the cheese plate, chips and dips, and ocean carpaccio for starters, as well as the Chilean sea bass and the 8 oz filet. This was especially disappointing, as 4 out of the 5 of us had planned to order either the filet or the sea bass.
How does a restaurant with such a limited entrée menu run out of two of its most basic offerings by 6:00 p.m. on a Saturday night? A smaller menu is perfectly fine, as long as the items are actually available. To make matters worse, the physical menu itself is enormous. It's a massive board that barely fits on the table, making it awkward to hold and nearly impossible to have a conversation. We could barely see one another over it, which felt more comical than luxurious.
With so many options already unavailable, my choices were extremely limited. I didn't want fish and chips, and a 14 oz ribeye was far more than I could reasonably eat, especially when I usually don't even finish an 8 oz filet. Both my daughter and I ultimately settled on the salmon. While it was decent, some bites tasted noticeably fishy.
I also don't believe we were the only guests feeling disappointed that evening. At the table directly next to ours, we watched two different couples arrive, order drinks, and then leave before even finishing their cocktails after being told that many menu items were no longer available. That alone speaks volumes.
Service was another issue. Our server, whose name I won't share, was very slow with drinks. My husband was already about three-quarters of the way through his meal before she returned with his glass of wine, which significantly impacted the dining experience.
Unfortunately, the evening ended on an even worse note. My daughter woke up at 4:00 a.m. with severe stomach pains and became sick shortly after. For a $550 birthday dinner, this was absolutely not the experience we were hoping for.
The ambiance at Wolf is undeniably amazing, and the setting alone makes it worth stopping by for a cocktail at sunset. However, the restaurant has a lot of work to do when it comes to food consistency, menu availability, and service. Would we return? Possibly, for drinks and the view. But not for dinner. Scottsdale has far too many incredible restaurants to justify spending that kind of money on a meal that falls short of expectations.
reviews.author: Krista C.

reviews.text: Went to their newly opened lunch. Cocktails were great as to be expected. Service was ok but got worse as it got busier, they're new so I'll give them that they are working it out. Shrimp tacos were way too breaded and would be so much better grilled. Goat cheese balls were delish, lobster ceviche tacos were great too. Ambiance is always nice and the view is great.
reviews.author: Lindsey B.

reviews.text:
Terrible. Came in at 5;30 on Saturday night. Immediately told the:

Filet was out
The tomahawk pork chop was out
The sea Bass was not available


Leaving the ribeye and the salmon as only entrees besides hamburgers and haddock (fish and chips) chicken and burgers.

Manager was quite rude when called out on his shitty job of being prepared.

Avoid this place!!!!
reviews.author: Fred F.

reviews.text: The atmosphere at LVP can't be beat. We went within their first month open, so I know they're still working out the service kinks (it's packed every single night). Parking was easy with either a lot or valet available. The drinks were super fun, too, we had an old fashioned and a mocktail. Food was good overall: goat cheese balls & Caesar for an app. I ordered the crudo carpaccio and my husband got the burger for dinner. Beautiful presentation, but the burger was a little dry.
reviews.author: Jenna N.

reviews.text: Go for A drink and nothing else.  Over-priced and disorganized.  Our server was awful, not that they all are, however; all 3 managers that we saw were just standing around and commiserating with the hostesses.  Waited 10 minutes for water, 20 minutes for our drinks then after more than an hour to take our order e we're told they were out of 4 of the 6 or so main courses.  Expected more from  Vanderpump  restaurant
reviews.author: Snarla B.

reviews.text: Had my birthday dinner tonight at Wolf. First off, the hostess was very sweet, the bartender was awesome and the server was phenomenal. The issue started with our reservation starting 20 mins late. The worst part was that the restaurant was out of half the menu. Including one of the signature cocktails, the filet, pork tomahawk and some of the desserts. How does that happen on a Friday night??  The food we had was really good just wasn't our first choice. The ambience is really nice though.
reviews.author: Chris N.

reviews.text:
Stopped by Wolf by Vanderpump in Scottsdale on New Year's Day for drinks and appetizers. The ambiance was amazing and the service was great. You can really see Lisa Vanderpump's vision throughout the restaurant--from the wolf-themed chairs to the rotating chandeliers. The space is visually stunning and has a fun, upscale vibe. Definitely a great spot for cocktails and soaking in the atmosphere.
I will definitely be back to try more of their menu.
reviews.author: Nia F.

reviews.text: so so yummy! lvp came up and talked to us for a couple minutes and made us feel very loved
reviews.author: Sarah M.

reviews.text: Dined at Wolf this last Sunday and our experience was nothing short of spectacular!! We were greeted with a warm welcoming smile from the hostess and were seated with server Kelsey immediately. The atmosphere was almost as breath taking as the sevice that Kelsey provided this evening! Kelsey recommended the blood orange old fashioned and the smoked maple manhattan and both were absolutely scrumptious!  Kelsey checked in on us just the right amount to make our time here feel like we were part of the Vanderpump family! Management swung by to make sure everything was up to par and we made sure to let him know our server was amazing, but still had to leave this review!! Thank you for providing service that far exceeded our expectations! We will absolutely be back to request Kelsey very soon!
reviews.author: Vincent V.

reviews.text:
My boyfriend and I ate at Wolf by Vanderpump to celebrate our anniversary. We are big Lisa fans and have eaten at her restaurants in Las Vegas and LA - so expectations were high. Wolf did not disappoint. The entire experience was very positive.

Since we were looking for a Friday evening, I made reservations about a week in advance to be safe. The restaurant never got completely full, but it was pretty busy, so do I recommend making a reservation. 

We were sat in a quiet corner by a fireplace. The entire ambiance is so unique and special. Everything looks and feels elevated. There are fun sculptures and lots of chandeliers throughout. Because we sat close to the entrance I didn't get to see further inside the restaurant, but they have a long bar, and lots of table options - including patio seating. 

The food was solid. Lots of delicious bites. To start we shared the Wolf Bread and Goat Cheese Balls. For mains, I got Ken's Haddock & Chips, my boyfriend got the Butter Seared Chilean Seabass. 

The bread and cheese balls were excellent. Definitely my favorite bites. My boyfriend really enjoyed his Chilean Seabass. He said the caper sauce carries the perfect notes of acidity to balance out the buttery fish. I enjoyed my fish & chips but the fries seemed out of place. With so many well-crafted dishes, I would expect fresh hand-cut fries or something that feels elevated. These were very run of the mill fries, the same you would find at any chain restaurant.

Our server was excellent. Super friendly and knowledgeable about the menu. She made us feel welcome right from the start. 

Looking forward to returning here again soon!
reviews.author: Sam M.

reviews.text: Looks good on the surface but once you get past the branding it's underwhelming. The food is average at best, portions are light, and the service feels like an afterthought. It's another celebrity concept built for hype rather than quality...the kind of place that replaces established venues instead of earning its spot. There's no reason to come back.
reviews.author: Marc D.

reviews.text: Having dined in previous restaurant before, it's amazing to see how they transformed this space - it looks like a completely different restaurant. The ambiance and whimsy of the decor made for a fun and unforgettable evening. Everything we tried was great, and we will return. Service was very friendly
reviews.author: Ashley H.

reviews.text: We are huge fans of Lisa Vanderpump, so had to give this place a go. I was extremely impressed with the ambiance, drinks, food, and service was top notch! Definitely impressed, and will be returning again. The dress code is a bit more upscale just a heads up. We loved our server, Amy! She was amazing.
reviews.author: Jenna L.

reviews.text: Mediocre at best! Decor was nice but they missed the mark for Scottsdale where we have so many amazing restaurants. We sat next to the bar and watched the bartender make the same martini and it was never the same size. One time she cleaned something out of the glass with her fingers and then filled the same glass back up. The bar is messy with garnish and trash on the floor. Maybe we went too close to it opening.... Think we will stick to Buck and Rider, Pyro or Global Ambassador!
reviews.author: Danielle C.

reviews.text:
Lovely experience with my gf and I for our anniversary. The Wolf Burger was delicious, service was special and Server was educated well on the menu and drink recommendations.

The vibes were excellent with multiple views of the mountain side of Scottsdale.
reviews.author: Daniel G.

reviews.text: We went with a group of 6 last night for NYE. They sat us and did not provide a drink menu so I had to ask for one which took another 20 minutes to receive so I just ended up looking up the cocktail menu up on my phone. I ordered a espresso martini with Baileys and it was not good at all (I order these regularly). It was super milky and no froth. Then I ordered a steak salad and they tried to receive a steak wrap instead. Then they tried to re-make it but it didn't arrive until our entire group was already done eating so I. just cancelled it and didn't have dinner for NYE. VERY disappointing experience.
reviews.author: Beata A.

reviews.text: We loved the experience. The Cheese balls and Sea bass were amazing! Creative cocktails also a plus!
reviews.author: Rick D.

reviews.text: Food is not worth it, cool atmosphere and okay cocktails. Would return for the drinks and a view. Service was backed up, they may need more staff or they are still working out the grooves.
reviews.author: Jessica P.

reviews.text:
From start to finish, this place absolutely delivered. The tartare tostadas were outstanding. Tuna was fresh and the aioli on top was a great touch. And the goat cheese balls were packed with flavor.
I also loved the Peter Rabbit drink--refreshing and loved the presentation of the drink. 
Huge shoutout to our server Gabrielle. She was incredibly knowledgeable, answered all our questions with confidence, and was attentive not just to our table all of them. Her recommendations were spot-on and really elevated the whole experience.
Can't wait to come back and try more--highly recommend!
reviews.author: Tianna B.

reviews.text: Had an amazing experience here! The hospitality was outstanding from start to finish, and the food was just as impressive. The atmosphere was fun and lively, making it a great place to enjoy a meal on a Saturday night. I ordered the burger and it was cooked to perfection--juicy, flavorful, and exactly how I wanted it. Even the little details stood out, like the blue cheese olives in my martini, which were absolutely delicious. Highly recommend and can't wait to come back!
reviews.author: Natalia I.

reviews.text: BEWARE! - The only reason to come to this place is for the views and maybe the cocktails (which are very hit or miss) - the food is lacking any creativity or flavor. Our food was bland and overcooked which at this price point is unacceptable. Extremely disappointing especially since we have had great experience at their Las Vegas location in the past. Save your money and go to Luna downstairs or a local restaurant.
reviews.author: Dvn S.

reviews.text:
We celebrated my Mother in law's 83 birthday last night.  Food was fantastic, decor was inviting, service was great.  Sarah was our server and she was amazing.  The sommelier was spot on.
Unfortunately with the extreme volume of the music we will never come back.  We spent the entire evening yelling at each other.  There was no way to enjoy one another's company.  Even the employees we spoke with agreed.  Why do restaurants do this?  A fine dining experience is meant to enjoy the atmosphere and the food while being able to communicate with your party.  Wrote an email to Paul Setola the Gm. but really do not expect a reply.  We would go back if this matter was rectified.  I can afford whatever I wish but choose to spend wisely.  Sad so much time , effort and money went into this restaurant only to ruin it with the volume switch.
reviews.author: Andrew G.

reviews.text:
We came here to celebrate my sister's birthday and had an absolutely amazing experience from start to finish. The food was delicious, the atmosphere was lively and welcoming, and it felt like the perfect place for a special occasion.

Our server, Amy, truly made the night extra special. She was so personable, fun, and attentive, and her energy really added to the celebration. She made sure everything was perfect, checked in at just the right times, and genuinely made us feel taken care of. We couldn't have asked for a better server!!!

Between the great service, incredible food, and awesome atmosphere, this was a night to remember. Huge shoutout to Amy and the entire team. we'll definitely be back!

reviews.text:
Last night was my first time dining here. A friend of mine, who has been coming since the restaurant opened and absolutely loves it, highly recommended that I give it a try. I made a reservation through OpenTable for 10:45 PM. There was a little confusion at the hostess stand upon arrival, but the staff was extremely friendly and able to get me seated.

I was seated at the bar at 10:54 PM. Unfortunately, after being seated, no one acknowledged me--not even to offer water. I waited until 11:09 PM without a greeting or service. There were three staff members behind the bar: two polishing glasses (one directly in front of me) and a bartender moving back and forth handling tasks, while guests around me were being served drinks. I was never asked if I wanted anything, not even water, nor was I greeted.

As this was my first visit, it wasn't the best first impression. I eventually went back to the hostess stand to let them know I was going to leave, as I didn't feel particularly welcomed. The hostess who initially seated me was genuinely apologetic and kind. As I was heading to the elevator, the general manager, Paul, stopped me to personally apologize and offered to buy me a drink, explaining that there were several hiccups that evening.

By that point, I had already decided to leave, so I didn't get the opportunity to eat or drink. I do appreciate the sincere apology from both the hostess and the general manager.

The space itself is beautiful, the menu looks divine, and the drink options are very appealing. I'm willing to give this restaurant another try once it's been around a bit longer and staff training and service flow are more refined--especially since the basic two-minute greeting rule was missed. It also wasn't particularly busy at the time, which made the situation more confusing.

I look forward to returning in the future and fingers crossed hopefully having a much better experience.

Imagine SUR - the vibe, the people, the food, the location. Now, make it even better. The view is striking. The decor and ambiance are one of a kind and lavish. The service is friendly, personal, quirky. I ordered caviar off the bat and they were out, but forgot to tell FOH. Imagine Tom Schwartz's quirky clone chasing it down, and then a manager, who was so kind. All of the servers, bartenders, and barbacks seem experienced and genuinely into what they're doing.

I did not expect this level of food. The tuna tartar tostada was the best I've had. The GOAT cheese balls lived up to their reputation. The drinks are strong, thought through, and there's an impressive variety of them. Honestly, I didn't even expect to go here tonight. Brought the kids on a tiny staycation for Christmas without realizing that the restaurant opened in the hotel and not in the mall. Saw it, and a spot, available on OpenTable. If you get the chance, give it a try for a solo our group date. 

They're going to open up for lunch starting tomorrow (12/26) and I'm interested to see how this evolves. I'd definitely snag a spot while it's lesser known.

reviews.text:
As a restaurant critic from Chicagoland area -- 


Wolf by Vanderpump | Scottsdale

Overall
For a restaurant barely a week old, this was a masterclass in execution. No grace period needed. Everything felt dialed in from the moment we arrived. Confident, polished, and fully realized.

Service
Paulina was exceptional. Ten years of serving experience and new to fine dining, yet she exceeded expectations with ease. Warm, attentive, and perfectly paced. Polished without being stiff. She elevated the evening effortlessly.

Food
Beautiful presentation and strong flavors across the board.
The salmon was flavorful and well balanced, rich without being overdone.
The Caesar salad was a standout for the experience alone. The little hammer and Parmesan crisp tableside moment was playful, memorable, and executed with intention. I love when restaurants invite guests into the experience rather than just dropping plates.
The crab and corn hush puppies were crispy, fresh, and genuinely delicious. Comforting yet refined.

Dessert
The brownie deserves a mention. Not the best brownie I've ever had, but the presentation was striking and indulgent. Slightly on the drier side, though balanced well with the accompaniments and easy to overlook given how strong the rest of the experience was. It still felt thoughtful and on brand.

Cocktails
Well crafted and cohesive with the menu. Balanced, smooth, and enjoyable start to finish.

Ambience & View
Stunning. The interior is classy, layered, and dramatic in all the right ways. From the lighting fixtures to the textures and finishes, the space feels luxurious without feeling cold. Located on the 7th floor of Caesars Republic Scottsdale, the nighttime views of Camelback Mountain quietly steal the show. It adds a sense of occasion that elevates the entire evening.

One fair critique
None. When I look for something to note, it usually comes up. This time, nothing did.

Ratings
Food: 9.5/10
Service: 10/10
Ambience: 10/10
Cocktails: 9/10
Overall: 9.7/10

Welcome to the table.

reviews.text:
AN UNFORGETTABLE EXPERIENCE AT WOLF - THREE VISITS IN ONE WEEK
I've had the incredible fortune of dining at Wolf three times in one week, and each visit offered a uniquely wonderful experience. This is destination dining at its finest.

VISIT 1 - SATURDAY (SOFT OPENING)
My bestie and I were dressed up taking Christmas photos on the eighth floor Terrace when the bartender told us about Wolf's soft opening. We headed down and secured what I believe is the restaurant's best table - perfectly positioned with expansive windows showcasing breathtaking views of Scottsdale Fashion Square and Camelback Mountain. Watching the sunset from this vantage point was pure magic.
We enjoyed: Caviar & Chips (1/2 oz Artisan Caviar, Crème Fraîche, Sea Salt & Chive, 18kt Gold Flake with Handcut Potato Chips - absolutely divine), Lobster Ceviche Crisps (Avocado Crema, Scallion, Citrus, Jicama Mango Slaw - fresh and beautifully executed), Tomato Salad (we substituted burrata for goat cheese, equally lovely), 14oz Prime Ribeye Tagliata (Salsa Verde, Heirloom Vegetables, WOLF Potatoes - generously sized, cooked to perfection, those Wolf Potatoes are unforgettable), and Stonefruit Cobbler (Vanilla Ice Cream, Brown Sugar) - the perfect finish.

VISIT 2 - WEDNESDAY (OFFICIAL OPENING)
My bestie, her sister, and I sat at the bar. I had a muddled cucumber mocktail while they enjoyed wine, and we shared the Chips & Dips sampler (Charred Elote Dip, Pink Beet Hummus, Market Vegetables, Handcut Potato Chips). The highlight? Head Chef Jason took a break to come out and meet everyone, sharing his culinary journey and even his business card. We'd actually dined at many of the places where he previously worked - what a small world and what a testament to his talent!

VISIT 3 - FRIDAY NIGHT (GROUP DINNER)
I returned with a group of seven friends who dine out regularly at top spots throughout the valley. I had the 14oz Prime Ribeye Tagliata again (it's that good!), while others enjoyed the cheese balls for appetizers - absolutely delicious. The best part? The coffee machine was finally up and running, and enjoying coffee with dessert was absolute perfection.

THE TEAM
What sets Wolf apart is the consistent, top-tier hospitality. Manager Paul and Assistant GM Gil made the rounds to every table on each visit, checking in with genuine warmth and attention - exactly what you'd expect from the valley's finest establishments. Our server Kelsey provided exceptional service on both my first and third visits, and Head Chef Jason's culinary creations speak for themselves. The host desk team has been welcoming and professional every single time.

PRO TIP
Arrive early or stay after dinner to enjoy the eighth floor Terrace at Caesars. Stunning skyline views with lounge seating - perfect for an aperitif or digestif with no cover charge. This is actually where I discovered Wolf's soft opening!

THE VERDICT
Wolf delivers on every level: ambiance, cuisine, service, and setting. Three visits in one week - from an intimate dinner for two, to a casual bar experience, to a group celebration - and each was flawless. Fair warning: they're already booked through mid-January, so make your reservations now. Highly recommend for special occasions or when you want something extraordinary.
